Revision.Source: Prepares a 2026 U.S. federal income tax return estimate. Import your tax documents with AI, answer only the questions your documents and situation raise, and see your estimated tax, payments and balance due or refund. One saved return per user; resume where you left off. Alpha version.
Revision.Target: 生成 2026 年美国联邦所得税申报估算。使用 AI 导入税务文件，仅回答根据您的文件和具体情况提出的问题，并查看估算税额、已缴税款以及应补税额或退税额。每位用户可保存一份申报表，并从上次中断处继续。Alpha 版本。

Revision.Source: Tax return prototype
Revision.Target: 报税原型

Revision.Source: Interview, saved accepted answers, and a U.S. federal tax year 2026 estimate. Use synthetic data only. This prototype does not file a return.
Revision.Target: 通过问答收集信息，保存已确认的答案，并估算美国2026纳税年度的联邦税。仅限使用模拟数据。本原型不提交纳税申报表。

Revision.Source: Tax return prototype
Revision.Target: 纳税申报原型

Revision.Source: Check the ABLE contributions: each amount must be zero or more.
Revision.Target: 请检查ABLE账户缴款：每笔金额均须大于或等于零。

Revision.Source: Enter the ABLE contributions only once for each beneficiary.
Revision.Target: 每位受益人的ABLE账户缴款只能录入一次。

Revision.Source: Supply this activity's individual at-risk facts on its income page.
Revision.Target: 请在此项活动的收入页面提供其自身的风险承担信息。

Revision.Source: The activity's combined loss or at-risk amounts cannot be represented; review the actual source amounts before calculating this return.
Revision.Target: 此项活动的合计亏损或风险承担金额超出可表示范围；请在计算本次申报的税额前核查实际原始金额。

Revision.Source: Review this source loss's limiting stage, original year, tax character, regular and AMT amounts, and qualified portions.
Revision.Target: 请核查这笔原始亏损所处的扣除限制阶段、最初发生年度、税务性质、常规税和替代性最低税（AMT）金额，以及符合资格的部分。

Revision.Source: Released prior at-risk losses need their original-year qualified business income status before completing the QBI deduction.
Revision.Target: 计算合格经营收入（QBI）扣除额前，须提供以前年度因风险承担限制而暂缓扣除、现已获准扣除的亏损在最初发生年度是否属于合格经营收入的信息。

Revision.Source: The adopted-child exception applies only to your own or adopted child who lived with you all year: choose Child as the relationship and All year.
Revision.Target: 收养子女例外仅适用于全年与您同住的亲生或收养子女：请将关系选择为“子女”，同住时间选择为“全年”。

Revision.Source: Each employer must be a W-2 of the employee it is entered for.
Revision.Target: 每个雇主都必须对应到所填员工本人的一份W-2表。

Revision.Source: A part paid after the death can't be more than the box it comes from.
Revision.Target: 去世后支付的部分不能超过其所属栏框的金额。

Revision.Source: The part of 2024 payments excluded from recapture cannot exceed the alimony paid in 2024.
Revision.Target: 2024年付款中不计入追回计算的部分不能超过2024年支付的配偶赡养费。

Revision.Source: The part of 2025 payments excluded from recapture cannot exceed the alimony paid in 2025.
Revision.Target: 2025年付款中不计入追回计算的部分不能超过2025年支付的配偶赡养费。

Revision.Source: Correct the original amortization sources before their combined amount can be calculated.
Revision.Target: 请先更正原始摊销资料，才能计算合计金额。

Revision.Source: Enter each ended annuity once.
Revision.Target: 每项已终止的年金只能录入一次。

Revision.Source: The tax-free part recovered cannot be more than the net investment in the contract.
Revision.Target: 已免税收回的部分不能超过年金合同的净投资额。

Revision.Source: The tax-free part recovered and the other tax-free refunds together cannot be more than the net investment.
Revision.Target: 已免税收回的部分与其他免税退款的合计金额不能超过净投资额。

Revision.Source: The combined annuity's remaining basis cannot be represented in the required amount field.
Revision.Target: 合并年金的剩余计税基础超出所需金额字段的可表示范围。

Revision.Source: Being someone else's qualifying child applies only to another person you support: choose that for this person, or untick it.
Revision.Target: “是他人的合格子女”仅适用于您供养的其他人：请为此人选择该身份，或取消勾选此项。

Revision.Source: The employer excess returned for 2026 cannot be more than the employer contributions.
Revision.Target: 退还的2026年度雇主超额缴款不能超过雇主缴款总额。

Revision.Source: The personal excess returned for 2026 cannot be more than the personal contributions.
Revision.Target: 退还的2026年度个人超额缴款不能超过个人缴款总额。

Revision.Source: The correction deadline cannot be before the deposit.
Revision.Target: 更正截止日期不能早于存款日期。

Revision.Source: A loss cannot be more than the principal returned.
Revision.Target: 亏损不能超过退还的本金。

Revision.Source: The excess cannot be returned before it was deposited.
Revision.Target: 超额缴款的退还日期不能早于其存入日期。

Revision.Source: Choose compensation that is still on your return: a W-2, a Form 8919 or a business.
Revision.Target: 请选择仍列在申报表中的报酬来源：W-2表、8919表或一项经营业务。

Revision.Source: Choose each compensation source once.
Revision.Target: 每个报酬来源只能选择一次。

Revision.Source: The employer part of the later deposits cannot be more than the employer contributions left after the excess returned.
Revision.Target: 后续存款中的雇主部分不能超过退还超额缴款后剩余的雇主缴款。

Revision.Source: The employer part of the later deposits cannot be more than all the later deposits.
Revision.Target: 后续存款中的雇主部分不能超过后续存款总额。

Revision.Source: The personal part of the later deposits cannot be more than the personal contributions left after the excess returned.
Revision.Target: 后续存款中的个人部分不能超过退还超额缴款后剩余的个人缴款。

Revision.Source: Enter each person's Archer MSA contributions once.
Revision.Target: 每人的Archer MSA账户缴款只能录入一次。

Revision.Source: The deposit cannot be after the last permitted date for a 2025 contribution.
Revision.Target: 存款日期不能晚于2025年度缴款的最后允许日期。

Revision.Source: Check the Archer MSA contributions: the dates and amounts must be valid, and each owner's coverage needs twelve months.
Revision.Target: 请检查Archer MSA账户缴款：日期和金额必须有效，且须提供每位账户持有人十二个月的保险覆盖信息。

Revision.Source: The section 179 amount cannot exceed the business share of the cost.
Revision.Target: 第179条扣除金额不能超过成本中用于经营的部分。

Revision.Source: This heavy passenger SUV has no listed design exception. Its section 179 election cannot exceed $32,000 for 2026; eligible bonus and regular depreciation may still apply to the remaining cost.
Revision.Target: 这辆重型乘用SUV不符合任何列明的设计例外条件。其2026年第179条选择扣除金额不能超过$32,000；剩余成本仍可能适用符合条件的额外折旧和常规折旧。

Revision.Source: The date bought cannot be after the date placed in service.
Revision.Target: 购买日期不能晚于投入使用日期。

Revision.Source: The actual Table B classification and ADS class life are unavailable. No depreciation benefit is included for the unresolved source.
Revision.Target: 缺少实际的表B分类和替代折旧制度（ADS）类别年限。此项资料尚未核实的资产不计入折旧税收优惠。

Revision.Source: The original recovery system or actual prior depreciation records are unavailable. No depreciation benefit is included for the unresolved source.
Revision.Target: 缺少最初采用的成本回收制度或实际的以前年度折旧记录。此项资料尚未核实的资产不计入折旧税收优惠。

Revision.Source: The property's actual ADS restrictions or annual foreign-use records are unavailable. No depreciation benefit is included for the unresolved source.
Revision.Target: 缺少此资产实际适用的ADS限制或各年度境外使用记录。此项资料尚未核实的资产不计入折旧税收优惠。

Revision.Source: Electing out of bonus depreciation applies to all 2026 property of the same kind; choose regular depreciation only for every such asset on this return, or for none.
Revision.Target: 选择不采用额外折旧，适用于2026年所有同类资产；请为本申报表中的每项此类资产都选择“仅采用常规折旧”，或全部不选。

Revision.Source: A credit cannot reduce the cost by more than the cost.
Revision.Target: 税收抵免用于调减成本的金额不能超过成本本身。

Revision.Source: The date sold or stopped using must be after the date placed in service.
Revision.Target: 出售或停止使用日期必须晚于投入使用日期。

Revision.Source: The earlier business use applies only to an asset placed in service before 2026 whose business use is 50% or less this year.
Revision.Target: 以前年度的经营使用比例仅适用于2026年前投入使用、且本年度经营使用比例为50%或以下的资产。

Revision.Source: This income-forecast property requires its original Form 8866 tax and annual source comparisons. Current forecast income cannot establish the mandatory lookback tax.
Revision.Target: 这项采用收入预测法的资产需要原始8866表税额及逐年原始数据对比。仅凭当前预测收入无法确定必须计算的追溯调整税额。

Revision.Source: The recovery source records conflict with this property's actual dates, classification, use or election. Correct the source records.
Revision.Target: 成本回收原始记录与此资产的实际日期、分类、用途或税务选择不符。请更正原始记录。

Revision.Source: Record {0}, property {1}: recovery source questions changed with your current owner, date, class or election answers. Review the source questions and save again. None of these edits has been saved yet.
Revision.Target: 记录{0}，资产{1}：成本回收相关问题已根据您当前对所有人、日期、类别或税务选择的回答发生变化。请核查相关问题并重新保存。这些修改均尚未保存。

Revision.Source: Property placed in service in 2026 needs a 2026 date placed in service.
Revision.Target: 2026年投入使用的资产，其投入使用日期必须在2026年。

Revision.Source: This historical accelerated property requires its actual separate straight-line AMT source; the regular allowance cannot supply it.
Revision.Target: 这项以前年度采用加速折旧的资产，需要其实际、单独的AMT直线法折旧原始资料；不能使用常规税折旧额代替。

Revision.Source: This disposition needs the actual creator and ownership history to establish its income character. The retained recovery facts alone do not establish it.
Revision.Target: 此次处置需要实际的创作者及所有权历史资料，才能确定收入的税务性质。仅凭已保留的成本回收信息无法确定。

Revision.Source: The actual property sources exceed the signed-cent financial carrier. Retain the original amounts; this estimate is unavailable.
Revision.Target: 此资产的实际原始金额超出可处理的以美分计的正负金额范围。请保留原始金额；无法提供此项估算。

Revision.Source: The original non-MACRS schedule or basis history is needed. An unexplained balance does not restart its original recovery period.
Revision.Target: 需要原始的非MACRS折旧明细表或计税基础历史记录。不能因存在来源不明的余额而重新开始原定成本回收期。

Revision.Source: The original non-MACRS source facts do not reconcile with this property's dates, basis, use and deductions. Correct the actual schedule or output records.
Revision.Target: 原始的非MACRS资料与此资产的日期、计税基础、用途及扣除额不符。请更正实际明细表或结果记录。

Revision.Source: Property placed in service before 2026 needs a date placed in service before 2026.
Revision.Target: 2026年前投入使用的资产，其投入使用日期必须早于2026年。

Revision.Source: This improvement needs its actual physical-building recovery facts and property classification. No depreciation benefit is included for the unresolved improvement.
Revision.Target: 这项改良需要其所在建筑实体的实际成本回收信息及资产分类。此项尚未核实的改良不计入折旧税收优惠。

Revision.Source: Business-acquisition software belongs with purchased section 197 intangibles; software development belongs with research costs. Correct its source classification.
Revision.Target: 收购企业时取得的软件应归入购入的第197条无形资产；软件开发应归入研究费用。请更正其原始分类。

Revision.Source: Use for the stated purpose cannot exceed all comparable use.
Revision.Target: 用于所述用途的使用量不能超过同一口径的总使用量。

Revision.Source: A required alternative-tax amount for {0} cannot be represented. No complete estimate is available.
Revision.Target: {0}所需的一项替代性最低税金额超出可表示范围。无法提供完整估算。

Revision.Source: Only a loss from 2017 or earlier can be a documented exception to the 90% limit.
Revision.Target: 只有2017年或更早年度的亏损，才能作为有凭证支持的90%限额例外。

Revision.Source: Reconcile the complete annual vehicle recovery history with the original schedule and prior depreciation total.
Revision.Target: 请核对完整的车辆逐年成本回收记录，确保其与原始明细表和以前年度折旧总额一致。

Revision.Source: When the deductions are more than the adjusted gross income, enter the negative taxable-income records.
Revision.Target: 扣除额超过调整后总收入时，请录入应税收入为负数的相关记录。

Revision.Source: A later Schedule J cannot be from a year before the base year it refigures.
Revision.Target: 用于重新计算基准年度的后续附表J，其所属年度不能早于该基准年度。

Revision.Source: Bad debt: principal collected on a purchased debt cannot be more than the price you paid plus the acquisition costs.
Revision.Target: 坏账：购入债权已收回的本金不能超过您支付的价款加取得费用。

Revision.Source: Bad debt: principal collected on a purchased debt must be less than its face amount; a fully collected debt has no loss.
Revision.Target: 坏账：购入债权已收回的本金必须低于其面值；已全额收回的债权没有亏损。

Revision.Source: Bad debt: a purchased debt with principal collected is calculated only when you bought it at its face amount. Check the price paid and the face amount.
Revision.Target: 坏账：对于已收回部分本金的购入债权，仅在按面值购入时才进行计算。请检查支付价款和面值。

Revision.Source: Bad debt: a contractor deposit or a former-home mortgage shortfall is a personal claim, never a debt held to earn investment income. Answer No to the investment question.
Revision.Target: 坏账：向承包商支付的订金或原自住房的抵押贷款缺口属于个人债权，绝不属于为获取投资收益而持有的债权。请在投资相关问题中选择“否”。

Revision.Source: Bad debt: the date you bought the debt cannot be after 2026.
Revision.Target: 坏账：购买债权的日期不能晚于2026年。

Revision.Source: Bad debt: the amount recovered or reimbursed cannot be more than the amount you advanced, paid or deposited.
Revision.Target: 坏账：收回或获偿的金额不能超过您垫付、支付或交存的金额。

Revision.Source: Annual instrument sources changed. Reopen this page before saving.
Revision.Target: 年度金融工具来源已更改。请重新打开此页面后再保存。

Revision.Source: This instrument already supplies its computed annual excess-premium deduction. Remove the duplicate manual deduction.
Revision.Target: 此金融工具已提供计算得出的年度超额溢价扣除额。请删除重复的手动扣除项。

Revision.Source: Name the different documented bond whose manual deduction this is.
Revision.Target: 请注明此手动扣除项所对应的另一只有凭证支持的债券名称。

Revision.Source: This deduction names an annual instrument no longer on the return. Reopen and select its actual source or remove the deduction.
Revision.Target: 此扣除项指定的年度金融工具已不在纳税申报表中。请重新打开并选择其实际来源，或删除此扣除项。

Revision.Source: The same accepted instrument is entered more than once as a manual bond-premium deduction.
Revision.Target: 同一已确认的金融工具被多次录入为手动债券溢价扣除项。

Revision.Source: Select this owner's accepted Form 8815, or leave this redemption record unlinked.
Revision.Target: 请选择此所有人的已确认8815表，或将此赎回记录保留为未关联状态。

Revision.Source: A purchased credit cannot be transferred again.
Revision.Target: 购买的税收抵免不能再次转让。

Revision.Source: These barter receipts need their actual income treatment. This estimate does not calculate that classification.
Revision.Target: 这些易货交易收入需要按其实际所得性质进行税务处理。本估算不计算此类归属。

Revision.Source: Enter the actual box 11 aggregate from the statement. Boxes 8–10 cannot supply a missing printed amount.
Revision.Target: 请输入报表第11栏实际列印的合计金额。不能用第8–10栏推算缺失的列印金额。

Revision.Source: The actual contract totals cannot be represented in this estimate. Keep the source records for review.
Revision.Target: 本估算无法表示实际合约合计金额。请保留原始记录以供核查。

Revision.Source: Reconcile boxes 8–10 with the actual printed box 11 aggregate.
Revision.Target: 请核对第8–10栏，使其与第11栏实际列印的合计金额相符。

Revision.Source: Identify whether these contracts have the listed special treatment.
Revision.Target: 请确认这些合约是否适用所列的特殊税务处理。

Revision.Source: A basis-correction code needs the basis actually printed by the broker. Review the source document or choose the applicable adjustment.
Revision.Target: 使用计税基础更正代码需要提供经纪商实际列印的计税基础。请核查原始文件，或选择适用的调整项。

Revision.Source: These first-sale creator receipts need their actual income treatment. They are not capital-sale proceeds in this estimate.
Revision.Target: 创作者首次出售所得的这些收入需要按其实际所得性质进行税务处理。在本估算中，这些收入不属于资本资产出售所得款项。

Revision.Source: The printed proceeds cannot establish this loss. Keep the broker’s separate statement for review.
Revision.Target: 列印的出售所得款项不足以确定此项亏损。请保留经纪商的单独说明以供核查。

Revision.Source: The statement cannot report both optional-method classifications on the same form.
Revision.Target: 同一张报表不能同时申报两种可选方法分类。

Revision.Source: This statement reports ordinary treatment that this capital-sale calculation does not cover.
Revision.Target: 此报表申报了按普通所得处理的项目，本资本资产出售计算未涵盖这些项目。

Revision.Source: The printed gross-proceeds and net-proceeds selections conflict. Check the actual statement.
Revision.Target: 依据报表列印内容所选的总出售款项与净出售款项选项相互冲突。请核查实际报表。

Revision.Source: The printed short-term and long-term selections conflict. Check the actual statement.
Revision.Target: 依据报表列印内容所选的短期与长期选项相互冲突。请核查实际报表。

Revision.Source: Correct the separate printed aggregation checkboxes in the broker document.
Revision.Target: 请在经纪商文件中更正各个对应列印汇总信息的复选框。

Revision.Source: This statement reports a qualified opportunity fund disposition. Keep its actual opportunity-fund records for review.
Revision.Target: 此报表申报了合格机会基金的处置。请保留该机会基金的实际记录以供核查。

Revision.Source: These actual sale amounts cannot be represented in this estimate. Keep the paper and records for review.
Revision.Target: 本估算无法表示这些实际出售金额。请保留纸质文件和记录以供核查。

Revision.Source: Supply your established basis or explicitly choose the existing conservative zero-basis treatment.
Revision.Target: 请提供已确定的计税基础，或明确选择现有的保守处理方式，将计税基础设为零。

Revision.Source: The reported sale date precedes the reported acquisition date.

Revision.Target: 适用慈善捐赠限额及扣除门槛前的本年度现金捐赠。

Revision.Source: Charitable contribution limits, oldest eligible carryovers, and the 2026 income floor are applied in the statutory class order.
Revision.Target: 按法定类别顺序适用慈善捐赠限额、最早的合格结转额及 2026 年以收入为基准的扣除门槛。

Revision.Source: Current gifts allowed after the charitable limits and floor.
Revision.Target: 适用慈善捐赠限额及扣除门槛后，本年度捐赠中允许扣除的金额。

Revision.Source: Only the current direct public-charity cash gift's 2026 60%-class percentage excess and any eligible share of the 2026 itemizer floor. The 2025 imported balance remains separate in its original contribution year; the appreciated-stock or student/whaling 30%-class carry is also shown separately. A 2026 balance can be used only in the five succeeding years, through 2031.
Revision.Target: 仅包括本年度直接向公共慈善机构捐赠的现金中，超过 2026 年 60% 类别比例限额的部分，以及符合条件的 2026 年分项扣除门槛分摊额。导入的 2025 年余额仍按原捐赠年度单独保留；增值股票或学生供养费／捕鲸费用的 30% 类别结转额也单独列示。2026 年余额仅可在随后五年内使用，截至 2031 年。

Revision.Source: Current and carried gifts allowed after the charitable limits and floor.
Revision.Target: 适用慈善捐赠限额及扣除门槛后，本年度及结转捐赠中允许扣除的金额。

Revision.Source: Floor-disallowed amount not carried: absent current contribution-year percentage excess, no floor amount can carry. Even when a current-year gift has percentage excess, a prior-year cash, stock or household balance consumed in 2026 does not gain a new contribution year.
Revision.Target: 因扣除门槛而不允许扣除且不予结转的金额：如果本捐赠年度没有超过比例限额的金额，门槛扣减额便不能结转。即使本年度捐赠超过比例限额，2026 年使用的以前年度现金、股票或家居用品余额也不会因此获得新的捐赠年度。

Revision.Source: Section 170(g) student-maintenance expense allowed under the 30%-of-AGI and residual 50%-of-AGI limits, after its 2026 0.5%-of-AGI floor share. Appreciated capital-gain property takes floor priority ahead of this class. This class is itemized only; any regular NOL limitation is reflected in the total charity deduction.
Revision.Target: 第 170(g) 条学生供养费用，在适用 AGI 的 30% 限额及剩余 50% 限额，并扣减其分摊的 2026 年 AGI 的 0.5% 门槛金额后，允许扣除的部分。分配门槛扣减额时，增值资本利得财产优先于此类别。此类别仅可作分项扣除；任何常规净经营亏损（NOL）限制均体现在慈善捐赠扣除总额中。

Revision.Source: Gross 2026 30%-class excess for student maintenance, plus its floor-disallowed share only when a percentage limit creates a carryover. It keeps its class and expires after 2031 unless used earlier; the total charity carryforward separately reflects any NOL reduction.
Revision.Target: 2026 年学生供养费用中超过 30% 类别限额的总额，加上其因扣除门槛而不允许扣除的份额，但该份额仅在比例限额产生结转额时计入。此金额保留原类别，除非提前用完，否则于 2031 年后失效；慈善捐赠结转总额会另行反映因 NOL 而作的任何调减。

Revision.Source: Section 170(g) actual student-hosting expense, at most $50 per qualifying student-month with at least 15 eligible days. It is a 30%-limit contribution for the use of the sponsoring organization, not a 60%-limit cash gift. Ineligible months, general household costs and reimbursement do not count.
Revision.Target: 第 170(g) 条下接待寄宿学生的实际费用，每名学生在至少有 15 个合格天数的月份最多可计入 50 美元。此费用属于供主办机构使用、适用 30% 限额的捐赠，而非适用 60% 限额的现金捐赠。不符合条件的月份、一般家庭开支及已获报销的费用不计入。

Revision.Source: Personally purchased used goods, qualifying road vehicles, short-held or nonappreciated public stock and basis-elected appreciated public stock after the 50%-of-AGI limit and 2026 floor, which is charged to appreciated stock at FMV and student maintenance before this class. The source includes Form 8283 Section A or B facts when required, but does not produce the attachment.
Revision.Target: 个人购入的二手物品、符合条件的道路车辆、短期持有或未增值的上市股票，以及选择按计税基础扣除的增值上市股票，在适用 AGI 的 50% 限额及 2026 年扣除门槛后的金额。分配门槛扣减额时，按公允市场价值计入的增值股票及学生供养费用先于此类别扣减。需要时，来源数据包括 Form 8283 的 A 部分或 B 部分资料，但不会生成该附件。

Revision.Source: Current noncash and other charitable gifts before the charitable limits and floor.
Revision.Target: 适用慈善捐赠限额及扣除门槛前的本年度非现金及其他慈善捐赠。

Revision.Source: 2026 supported noncash 50%-limit excess plus its floor-disallowed share only when any charitable percentage limit creates a carryover in the contribution year. This class keeps its 50% limit and expires after 2031 unless used earlier.
Revision.Target: 2026 年受支持的非现金捐赠中超过 50% 限额的金额，加上其因扣除门槛而不允许扣除的份额；该份额仅在捐赠年度有任何慈善捐赠比例限额产生结转额时计入。此类别保留其 50% 限额，除非提前用完，否则于 2031 年后失效。

Revision.Source: Supported noncash 50%-limit excess retained from a year using the standard deduction, without any 0.5% itemizer floor. The five following years end in 2031.
Revision.Target: 从采用标准扣除额的年度保留的、受支持的非现金捐赠中超过 50% 限额的金额，不适用任何 0.5% 分项扣除门槛。其后五年截至 2031 年。

Revision.Source: Current-year cash/service, supported noncash gifts, appreciated public stock and 30%-class student maintenance above their 2026 percentage limits retain their gift classes and year even when the standard deduction is selected. The standard-route cash deduction counts only qualifying cash gifts made to eligible organizations; the separately computed carryover keeps the hypothetical itemized percentage limits and excludes the itemizer-only 0.5% floor.
Revision.Target: 本年度现金／服务费用、受支持的非现金捐赠、增值上市股票及 30% 类别学生供养费用中，超过各自 2026 年比例限额的部分，即使选择标准扣除额，也仍保留原捐赠类别及年度。采用标准扣除额时的现金捐赠扣除，仅计入向合格机构作出的合格现金捐赠；单独计算的结转额仍采用假设选择分项扣除时的比例限额，但不包括仅适用于分项扣除的 0.5% 门槛。

Revision.Source: Current-year 60%-class cash/service, 50%-class property, 30%-class public stock at FMV, and 30%-class student-maintenance and whaling percentage-limit excess, plus only the current-year floor share when such an excess exists. Retain each class and the 2026 year; the five following years end in 2031. After reducing any amount that increased retained regular NOLs. Imported cash and supported 2025 stock and household balances retain their original years; other imported classes require further worksheets.
Revision.Target: 本年度 60% 类别现金／服务费用、50% 类别财产、按公允市场价值计入的 30% 类别上市股票，以及 30% 类别学生供养费和捕鲸费用中超过比例限额的金额；仅当存在此类超额时，再加上本年度门槛分摊额。各金额保留原类别及 2026 年年度，其后五年截至 2031 年。须先减去曾增加所保留常规 NOL 的金额。导入的现金余额，以及受支持的 2025 年股票和家居用品余额，均保留原年度；其他导入类别需要进一步的工作表计算。

Revision.Source: Charitable excess removed because it increased regular NOL carryforward; the same amount cannot remain in both carryovers.
Revision.Target: 因增加常规净经营亏损（NOL）结转额而移除的慈善捐赠超额；同一金额不能同时保留在两类结转额中。

Revision.Source: Combined section 170(g) student-maintenance and section 170(n) whaling contribution after the shared 30%-of-AGI and amended residual 50%-of-AGI limits and the 2026 itemizer floor. Both are current-year 30%-class contributions; the sources identify eligible amounts separately, but neither statute assigns the shared deduction between them. Any regular NOL limit appears in the total charity deduction.
Revision.Target: 第 170(g) 条学生供养费用与第 170(n) 条捕鲸捐赠的合计金额，在适用共用的 AGI 30% 限额、修订后的剩余 AGI 50% 限额及 2026 年分项扣除门槛后的金额。两者均属于本年度 30% 类别捐赠；各来源分别确定符合条件的金额，但两项法条均未规定如何在两者之间分配共用扣除额。任何常规 NOL 限额均体现在慈善捐赠扣除总额中。

Revision.Source: Combined 2026 30%-class percentage-limit excess for hosted-student and statutory-capped whaling claims, plus the class's floor share only when a percentage limit creates a carryover. This shared class expires after 2031 unless used earlier; whaling costs beyond the separate $50,000-per-captain statutory cap do not carry.
Revision.Target: 2026 年寄宿学生供养费用及受法定上限约束的捕鲸费用中，超过 30% 类别比例限额的合计金额；仅当比例限额产生结转额时，再加上此类别的门槛分摊额。此共用类别除非提前用完，否则于 2031 年后失效；超过每名船长单独适用的 50,000 美元法定上限的捕鲸费用不得结转。

Revision.Source: Prior-year carryover treated as paid within the 2026 percentage limit but not deducted because this return takes the standard deduction.
Revision.Target: 以前年度的结转额在2026年百分比限额内视为已支付，但由于本次申报采用标准扣除，因此不予扣除。

Revision.Source: Prior-year public-charity cash balance deducted on Schedule A line 14 (carryover from prior year) after the 2026 60% ceiling and 0.5%-of-AGI floor. A standard-deduction return claims none.
Revision.Target: 以前年度向公共慈善机构现金捐赠的余额，在应用2026年60%的上限和调整后总收入（AGI）0.5%的起扣门槛后，于附表A第14行（以前年度结转额）扣除。采用标准扣除的申报不申领此项扣除。

Revision.Source: Unused 2021 cash balance after the 2026 percentage-limit calculation expires rather than moving to 2027.
Revision.Target: 2021年现金捐赠余额在完成2026年百分比限额计算后仍未使用的部分将到期失效，不再结转至2027年。

Revision.Source: The 2026 0.5%-of-AGI floor reduces the imported carryover's current deduction; it does not create a new contribution-year carryover for a 2021–2025 gift.
Revision.Target: 2026年AGI的0.5%起扣门槛会减少已导入结转额的当年扣除额；不会为2021至2025年的捐赠产生新的捐赠年度结转额。

Revision.Source: Original-year balance left after 2026 percentage-limit use. A 2021 contribution expires after 2026; a later year's unused balance retains its original five-year period.
Revision.Target: 原捐赠年度余额在按2026年百分比限额使用后剩余的部分。2021年的捐赠在2026年结束后到期；之后年度的未使用余额仍沿用原有的五年期限。

Revision.Source: This original-year cash balance uses 2026 room oldest first after current-year public-charity gifts. A supported ordinary goods or vehicle gift reduces its aggregate 60%-of-AGI room; in the appreciated-stock pairing, current cash and then this balance use the 60% room before stock uses the remaining 50% room and separate 30% ceiling. With a hosted-student or whaling claim, current direct cash uses the 60% room first, then this older balance, then the 30%-class claim; that class's residual 50% limit restores up to 10% of AGI of the total cash. The balance is treated as paid even in a standard-deduction year; treatment as paid alone is not a tax deduction.
Revision.Target: 在当年向公共慈善机构的捐赠之后，这些原捐赠年度的现金余额按最早年度优先的顺序使用2026年的可用额度。有凭证支持的普通物品或车辆捐赠会减少其合计AGI的60%可用额度；与增值股票捐赠并存时，先由当年现金捐赠、再由此余额使用60%的额度，随后股票捐赠使用剩余的50%额度，并另受30%上限约束。有接待学生或捕鲸费用扣除时，先由当年直接现金捐赠使用60%的额度，再由此较早年度余额使用，最后由30%类别的扣除使用；该类别适用的剩余50%限额会使现金总额中最多相当于AGI的10%的部分恢复为可用额度。即使在采用标准扣除的年度，此余额也视为已支付；仅视为已支付并不等于可享受税务扣除。

Revision.Source: Unused 2022–2025 original-year cash balances available for a later return, subject to each original five-year expiry and intervening-use rules.
Revision.Target: 2022至2025年原捐赠年度的未使用现金余额可用于以后年度的申报，但须遵守各自原有的五年到期限制及其间年度的使用规则。

Revision.Source: A percentage-usable prior noncash balance is treated as paid, but not deductible, in a standard-deduction year.
Revision.Target: 以前年度非现金捐赠余额中符合百分比限额、可使用的部分，在采用标准扣除的年度视为已支付，但不可扣除。

Revision.Source: Imported 2025 household-furnishing balance included once in 2026 Schedule A line 14 (carryover from prior year) after percentage limits and the itemizer floor; no itemized deduction is claimed on the standard route.
Revision.Target: 导入的2025年家居用品捐赠余额，在应用百分比限额和分项扣除起扣门槛后，计入2026年附表A第14行（以前年度结转额），且只计入一次；采用标准扣除时不申领分项扣除。

Revision.Source: The 2026 itemizer floor reduces this imported 2025 deduction; it cannot turn the older gift into a new 2026 carryover.
Revision.Target: 2026年分项扣除起扣门槛会减少此项导入的2025年扣除额；不能将较早年度的捐赠变为新的2026年结转额。

Revision.Source: Reconciled unused 2025 50%-class balance entering 2026; it is not a current-year gift.
Revision.Target: 经核对后带入2026年的2025年50%类别未使用余额；不属于当年捐赠。

Revision.Source: Unused 2025 50%-class balance available in 2027, subject to intervening use; the five following years end after 2030, not after 2031.
Revision.Target: 2025年50%类别的未使用余额可在2027年使用，但须考虑其间年度的使用情况；其后五年的期限截至2030年末，而非2031年末。

Revision.Source: 2025 balance treated as paid after 2026 cash, 50%-class property and allowable 30%-class public stock use the 50%-of-AGI room. This older 50%-class balance then precedes a 2025 30%-class stock carry. Treatment as paid alone is not a tax deduction.
Revision.Target: 2026年的现金捐赠、50%类别财产捐赠及允许扣除的30%类别上市股票捐赠使用AGI的50%额度后，2025年余额才视为已支付。此项较早年度的50%类别余额又优先于2025年30%类别的股票结转额使用。仅视为已支付并不等于可享受税务扣除。

Revision.Source: Prior 2025 balance treated as paid within the 2026 percentage limits but not deducted because this return takes the standard deduction.
Revision.Target: 2025年的以前年度余额在2026年百分比限额内视为已支付，但由于本次申报采用标准扣除，因此不予扣除。

Revision.Source: Prior 2025 public-stock balance included once in the 2026 Schedule A line 14 carryover from prior year, after the current-year percentage ceilings and itemizer floor. A standard-deduction return claims none.
Revision.Target: 2025年的以前年度上市股票捐赠余额，在应用当年百分比上限和分项扣除起扣门槛后，计入2026年附表A第14行的以前年度结转额，且只计入一次。采用标准扣除的申报不申领此项扣除。

Revision.Source: The 2026 itemizer floor reduces the imported 2025 balance's deduction and cannot create a new 2026 contribution-year carryover.
Revision.Target: 2026年分项扣除起扣门槛会减少导入的2025年余额可扣除的金额，且不能产生新的2026捐赠年度结转额。

Revision.Source: Reconciled unused 2025 30%-class FMV balance entering 2026; original donation is not entered again as a 2026 gift.
Revision.Target: 经核对后带入2026年的2025年30%类别公允市值（FMV）未使用余额；原捐赠不会作为2026年捐赠再次录入。

Revision.Source: Original adjusted basis retained with the 2025 Form 8283 Section A facts and any future capital-gain-property election review; the 2026 FMV carry path does not use basis as its claim.
Revision.Target: 保留原调整后计税基础，以供2025年表格8283的A节资料及今后审查资本利得财产相关选择时使用；2026年按公允市值结转时，不以计税基础作为申领金额。

Revision.Source: Original 2025 public-market fair value of the directly donated long-term stock lot. This is Form 8283 Section A evidence, not a second contribution or 2026 deduction.
Revision.Target: 直接捐赠的该批长期持有股票在2025年公开市场上的原始公允价值。这是表格8283的A节证明资料，不是第二笔捐赠，也不是2026年的扣除额。

Revision.Source: Unused original-year 30%-class balance still available in 2027, subject to intervening use; its five following carry years are 2026 through 2030, not 2026 through 2031.
Revision.Target: 原捐赠年度30%类别的未使用余额在2027年仍可使用，但须考虑其间年度的使用情况；其后五个结转年度为2026至2030年，而非2026至2031年。

Revision.Source: 2025 balance treated as paid in 2026 after current-year stock gifts use the 30%-class and residual public-charity 50% limits. Treatment as paid alone does not mean a tax deduction.

Revision.Source: Gross 2026 30%-class FMV stock excess, plus its floor share only when a percentage ceiling creates a carryover. Retain this class through 2031; the total carryforward separately reflects any NOL reduction.
Revision.Target: 2026年按公允市值计算的30%类别股票捐赠超限总额；仅在百分比上限产生结转额时，才加上该类别因起扣门槛而不得扣除的份额。此类别保留至2031年；结转总额另行反映净经营亏损（NOL）造成的任何调减。

Revision.Source: Purchased, section 1014 inherited or ordinary section 1015 gifted publicly traded stock delivered to an eligible public charity: short-held or nonappreciated shares claim the lesser of FMV and basis in the 50% class; appreciated long-term shares claim FMV in the 30% class or basis under the annual reduction election. Revision.Target: 向合资格公共慈善机构交付的上市股票，包括购买取得、依第1014条继承取得或依第1015条一般赠与取得的股票：短期持有或未增值的股票，按公允市值与计税基础中的较低者在50%类别中申领扣除；长期持有且已增值的股票，按公允市值在30%类别中申领，或根据年度减额选择按计税基础申领。捐赠不实现出售利得；非现金捐赠总额超过$500时，适用表格8283的A节。

Revision.Source: Appreciated public stock at FMV after the separate 30%-of-AGI and remaining public-charity 50%-of-AGI ceilings. The 2026 itemizer floor charges this class first. No immediate standard-route deduction; the total charity deduction separately reflects any NOL limit.
Revision.Target: 按公允市值计算的增值上市股票捐赠，在应用单独的AGI的30%上限和公共慈善捐赠剩余的AGI的50%上限后的金额。2026年分项扣除起扣门槛优先从此类别中扣减。采用标准扣除时不能立即扣除此项；慈善捐赠扣除总额另行反映任何净经营亏损（NOL）限制。

Revision.Source: Unreimbursed direct volunteer service expense: qualifying car, away travel, uniform, foster care, selected-youth outing or permanent diaconate cost. Revision.Target: 未获报销的直接志愿服务费用：符合条件的车辆、离家旅行、制服、寄养照护、特定青少年出游或终身执事服务费用。此项只计入现金捐赠类别一次；捐出的时间和个人费用不可扣除。请保留可靠的书面记录及任何规定须取得的慈善机构确认函。

Revision.Source: Applied to the minimum tax credit available at the beginning of 2027, 33 1/3 cents for each dollar.

Revision.Source: Applied to the 2026 net capital loss and capital loss carryovers.

Revision.Target: 982表第1a栏和第2行：在经法院确认的第12章或第13章破产案件中解除的债务免计入收入，不受偿付能力限额约束。税收属性在计算本年度所得税后调减。

Revision.Target: 982表第2行：可免计入收入的已解除债务，以解除债务前一刻负债超过全部资产公允市值的金额为限。其余部分须纳税。

Revision.Source: Farm debt applied to the basis of qualified property: depreciable property, then farm land, then other.

Revision.Target: 请选择同一经营活动中实际存在且已确认的会计方法变更来源，并保留其批准或自动变更证明。请先保存新记录，再重新打开此页面，关联分配给这些记录的标识。

Revision.Source: Farm-only expense line in a business that is not a farm ({0}). Only a farm reports on Schedule F; enter this expense on its Schedule C line 8-27b, or as a described other expense on line 27b.
Revision.Target: 非农场业务（{0}）中使用了农场专用费用项目。只有农场使用附表F申报；请将此费用填入该业务附表C的第8至27b行中的适用行，或在第27b行作为其他费用填写并附上说明。

Revision.Source: The farm optional method applies to all of one person's farms: give each of their farms the same answer.
Revision.Target: 农场自雇税可选计算方法适用于同一个人的所有农场：请为其每个农场选择相同的答案。

Revision.Source: Check the actual ordinary farm other-income source and signed amount.
Revision.Target: 请核查农场实际的普通其他收入来源及带正负号的金额。

Revision.Source: Describe the actual additional farm source only when Other is selected.
Revision.Target: 仅在选择“其他”时，才需描述实际的额外农场来源。

Revision.Source: Production cost allocations must be nonnegative, disjoint, and no greater than their identified paid or incurred cost.
Revision.Target: 生产成本的分摊金额必须为非负数，不得重复分摊，且不得超过其对应的已支付或已发生成本。

Revision.Source: Check the identified production record, actual production/service dates and retained source basis.
Revision.Target: 请核对所指定的生产记录、实际生产或服务日期，以及留存的原始依据。

Revision.Source: The de minimis election excludes inventory and section 263A costs. Enter independently eligible purchases in ordinary business expenses; use actual ordinary, meal or nondeductible treatment for production costs.
Revision.Target: 微额费用扣除选择不适用于存货和第263A条规定的成本。请将独立符合条件的采购计入日常经营费用；生产成本则应根据实际情况按普通费用、餐饮费用或不可扣除费用处理。

Revision.Source: Enter the actual original uniform-capitalization election year and supporting statement.
Revision.Target: 请输入最初作出统一资本化选择的实际年份及其支持声明。

Revision.Source: Released inventory cost cannot exceed its actual available unrecovered regular or AMT basis.
Revision.Target: 转出的存货成本不得超过其实际可用、尚未收回的常规税或替代性最低税（AMT）计税基础。

Revision.Source: The investment credit for the property of a farm rental is not calculated.
Revision.Target: 不计算农场出租财产的投资税收抵免。

Revision.Source: Review the property-use records for the farm rental property you sold, then save again. None of these edits has been saved yet.
Revision.Target: 请检查您已出售的农场出租财产的使用记录，然后重新保存。这些修改均尚未保存。

Revision.Source: Use the supported number of distinct farm source records.
Revision.Target: 不同农场原始记录的数量须在支持的范围内。

Revision.Source: A claimed binding purchase needs its actual quantity, price and delivery terms and a business purpose beyond reducing tax. If terms are unestablished, choose that answer instead of claiming a current unused-supply deduction.
Revision.Target: 若主张采购具有约束力，须提供实际的数量、价格和交付条款，并具有减税以外的经营目的。如果条款尚未确定，请选择相应答案，不要申报本期未使用物资的扣除。

Revision.Source: The refund of this current unused payment cannot exceed its original paid amount. A recovery of a prior deducted payment needs its separate income source.
Revision.Target: 这笔本期尚未使用的付款，其退款不得超过原支付金额。收回以前已扣除的付款时，须另行记录其收入来源。

Revision.Source: Class income must already be included once in the matching raised or purchased product receipts; exclude business-use animal sales.
Revision.Target: 该类别的收入必须已在对应的自养或购入产品销售收入中计入一次；不包括经营用牲畜的销售收入。

Revision.Source: Check actual total, normal and weather-forced animal counts and the class income.
Revision.Target: 请核对实际出售总头数、正常出售头数、因天气被迫出售的头数，以及该类别的收入。

Revision.Source: Check the actual federal assistance designation date, or leave the unknown date absent.
Revision.Target: 请核对获指定可接受联邦援助的实际日期；如日期不明，请留空。

Revision.Source: Combine this farm's source records within each generic livestock class; do not subdivide by age, breed or sex.
Revision.Target: 请按牲畜大类合并该农场的原始记录，不要按年龄、品种或性别细分。

Revision.Source: The raised-for-sale portion cannot exceed this record's class income.
Revision.Target: 为出售而饲养的部分所对应的收入不得超过本记录中该类别的收入。

Revision.Source: Supply the weather relationship and usual-practice evidence from actual records.
Revision.Target: 请根据实际记录，提供与天气的关联及惯常做法的证据。

Revision.Source: Use distinct actual years within the preceding three years; a new farm can use regional usual-practice evidence.
Revision.Target: 请使用此前三年内互不重复的实际年份；新农场可使用当地惯常做法的证据。

Revision.Source: Federal income tax withheld cannot exceed the farm's income.
Revision.Target: 预扣的联邦所得税不得超过农场收入。

Revision.Source: Answer the separate FBAR filing-requirement question for a foreign account; leave it empty when no foreign account is reported.
Revision.Target: 如有境外账户，请回答单独列出的FBAR申报义务问题；未报告境外账户时，请将其留空。

Revision.Target: 需要申报FBAR时，请选择须在FBAR中报告的账户所在国家；回答“否”时，请将列表留空。

Revision.Source: A 1099-R with code T for age 59½ is dated before the owner turned 59½: check the distribution date and birth date, or choose disability as the reason.
Revision.Target: 以年满 59½ 岁为由使用代码 T 的 1099-R，其日期早于账户所有人年满 59½ 岁之日：请核对分配日期和出生日期，或将原因改为残疾。

Revision.Source: A 2025 household-furnishing carryover alongside a 2026 regular or AMT operating loss requires coordinated Form 172 and charitable-carryover worksheets, including on the standard route.
Revision.Target: 2025 年家居用品捐赠结转额与 2026 年常规税或 AMT 经营亏损并存时，需要统筹编制表格 172 和慈善捐赠结转工作表；采用标准扣除方式时也不例外。

Revision.Source: A 2025 household-furnishing carryover with a prior cash or other unsupported carryover class or a 2026 hosted-student/whaling 30%-class contribution needs a coordinated worksheet. One documented 2025 public-stock 30%-class carryover may be entered with this balance when the original-year combined worksheet is reconciled.
Revision.Target: 2025 年家居用品捐赠结转额与以前年度现金捐赠或其他不受支持类别的结转额，或 2026 年适用 30% 限额的接待学生／捕鲸支出捐赠并存时，需要统筹编制工作表。原捐赠年度的合并工作表核对一致后，可随此余额录入一笔有凭证的、适用 30% 限额的 2025 年上市股票捐赠结转额。

Revision.Source: A 2025 household-furnishing carryover with regular or AMT operating-loss history or a foreign tax credit needs coordinated carryover and allocation worksheets.
Revision.Target: 2025 年家居用品捐赠结转额与常规税或 AMT 经营亏损记录或外国税收抵免并存时，需要统筹编制结转及分配工作表。

Revision.Source: A charitable carryover alongside a 2026 regular or AMT operating loss requires coordinated Form 172 and charitable-carryover worksheets, even if this return takes the standard deduction.
Revision.Target: 慈善捐赠结转额与 2026 年常规税或 AMT 经营亏损并存时，需要统筹编制表格 172 和慈善捐赠结转工作表，即使本申报表采用标准扣除也不例外。

Revision.Source: A 2026 qualified Roth-to-HSA funding transfer together with 529-to-Roth transfers needs separate source-date and basis accounting.
Revision.Target: 2026 年合格的 Roth 转 HSA 资金划转与 529 转 Roth 划转并存时，需要分别核算资金来源日期和计税基础。

Revision.Source: A beneficiary's current regular or AMT operating loss needs a combined loss-year and source allocation with the final estate/trust K-1 carryover.
Revision.Target: 受益人本年的常规税或 AMT 经营亏损，需要与遗产／信托最终 K-1 的结转额合并，按亏损年度和来源进行分配。

Revision.Source: A binding issuer-wide section 1202 eligible-gain cap with 50%, 75% or 100% acquisition cohorts needs an explicit allocation of that cap across cohorts.
Revision.Target: 当第 1202 条适用于同一发行人的合格收益总上限构成实际限制，且存在适用 50%、75% 或 100% 比例的不同购入批次时，需要明确将该上限分配至各批次。

Revision.Source: A binding issuer-wide section 1202 limit with both empowerment-zone and ordinary gain needs a verified allocation between 60% and 50% eligible gain.
Revision.Target: 当第 1202 条适用于同一发行人的总限额构成实际限制，且同时存在振兴区收益和普通收益时，需要核实适用 60% 与 50% 比例的合格收益之间的限额分配。

Revision.Source: A changed minimum-tax-credit balance remaining after the restoration year requires post-restoration coordination before finalizing this comparison.
Revision.Target: 若偿还年度之后剩余的最低税抵免余额发生变化，必须先统筹处理偿还年度之后的相关影响，再确定此项比较结果。

Revision.Source: A church employee or ministerial W-2 must show zero Social Security and Medicare wages (boxes 3 and 5); box 1 is reported on Schedule SE line 5a for church employees or line 2 for ministerial services.
Revision.Target: 教会员工或神职服务的 W-2 上，社会保障税工资和 Medicare 税工资（第 3 栏和第 5 栏）必须为零；第 1 栏金额应申报在附表 SE 上，教会员工填第 5a 行，神职服务填第 2 行。

Revision.Source: A claimed casualty loss with Form 1116, a prior AMT operating loss or an inherited estate/trust NOL needs coordinated source and loss-absorption worksheets.
Revision.Target: 申报灾损扣除，同时涉及表格 1116、以前年度 AMT 经营亏损或继承的遗产／信托净经营亏损（NOL）时，需要统筹编制来源及亏损抵用工作表。

Revision.Source: A current or carried Form 3800 credit with a negative Form 8978 line 14 needs a combined Form 3800 and Schedule 3 line 6l tax-capacity worksheet.
Revision.Target: 本年或结转的表格 3800 抵免与表格 8978 第 14 行负数并存时，需要合并编制表格 3800 和附表 3 第 6l 行的可抵减税额工作表。

Revision.Source: A current regular or AMT operating loss with a noncash charitable deduction needs coordinated Form 172 and charitable-carryover worksheets.
Revision.Target: 本年常规税或 AMT 经营亏损与非现金慈善捐赠扣除并存时，需要统筹编制表格 172 和慈善捐赠结转工作表。

Revision.Source: A death exception must agree with the account owner's final-return death date.
Revision.Target: 死亡豁免必须与账户所有人最终申报表上的死亡日期一致。

Revision.Source: A deceased shareholder's K-1 with suspended losses can't also have no other death-related adjustment: say that an adjustment applies on the person's page, and the suspended losses are left out of this final return.
Revision.Target: 已故股东的 K-1 如有暂缓扣除的亏损，就不能同时注明没有其他死亡相关调整：请在该人员页面上注明需要调整，系统会将这些暂缓扣除的亏损排除在本次最终申报表之外。

Revision.Source: A deductible interest amount requires a positive investment-asset basis for that tax system; zero-basis or substantially distorted holdings require another valuation worksheet.
Revision.Target: 利息扣除额要求该税制下的投资资产计税基础为正数；计税基础为零或数值严重失真的持有资产需要另行编制估值工作表。

Revision.Source: A different joint-filing unit between 2025 and 2026 needs a complete prior-return recapture and ownership review.
Revision.Target: 2025 年与 2026 年联合申报的人员组合不同时，需要全面复核以前年度申报表的税收优惠追回事项及所有权归属。

Revision.Source: A direct 2026 public-charity cash gift, one ordinary 2026 property or personal road-vehicle claim, and the full reconciled 2025 cash balance are estimated together only when their total fits within 50% of AGI. Above that boundary, amended section 170(b)(1)(G)(i) and retained section 170(b)(1)(G)(iii)(II) impose reciprocal A/G ceilings without settled 2026 allocation guidance; no deduction or carryover is reported as settled.
Revision.Target: 仅当合计金额不超过调整后总收入（AGI）的 50% 时，才会将 2026 年直接向公共慈善机构捐赠的现金、一笔 2026 年普通财产或个人道路车辆捐赠扣除申报，以及经完整核对的 2025 年现金捐赠余额一并估算。超过此界限时，修订后的第 170(b)(1)(G)(i) 条和保留的第 170(b)(1)(G)(iii)(II) 条会对 A/G 类别施加相互制约的上限，而 2026 年的分配指引尚未确定；任何扣除额或结转额均不会作为确定结果列报。

Revision.Source: A farming NOL requires an explicit valid carryback waiver or the separate 2024/2025 carryback computations. Missing, uncertain or ineligible elections never become an automatic waiver.
Revision.Target: 农业净经营亏损（NOL）需要明确、有效的向前结转放弃选择，或分别进行 2024 年／2025 年的向前结转计算。缺失、不确定或不符合资格的选择，绝不会自动视为放弃。

Revision.Source: A farm-land disposition with home-office use requires gain/loss attribution to the home's business-income limit before coordinating the supply ceiling. Operating receipts alone do not establish that limit.
Revision.Target: 处置涉及住宅办公用途的农地时，必须先将收益／亏损归入该住宅的营业收入限额，再统筹计算可用额度上限。仅凭经营收入不足以确定该限额。

Revision.Source: A filer claimed as a dependent does not share Marketplace premiums with the premium tax credit (Pub. 974 specified premiums).
Revision.Target: 被他人申报为受抚养人的申报者，其医保市场保费不与保费税收抵免共同分配计算（第 974 号出版物所指的特定保费）。

Revision.Source: A filer who can be claimed as a dependent but is not claimed reconciles advance credit under Pub. 974's rules for an individual not included in a tax family (Form 8962 lines 11 to 23 column (f)), which is not calculated.
Revision.Target: 可被他人申报为受抚养人但实际未被申报的申报者，应按第 974 号出版物中关于未纳入纳税家庭的个人的规则，核算预付抵免（表格 8962 第 11 至 23 行的 (f) 栏）；本应用不计算此项。

Revision.Source: A foreign adoption not final before 2026 cannot have a prior exclusion-limit claim; prior taxable benefits need the foreign-adoption worksheet.
Revision.Target: 2026 年之前尚未最终完成的境外收养，不能有以前年度的免税限额申报；以前年度的应税福利需要使用境外收养工作表处理。

Revision.Source: A Form 1099-A for a crop forfeited to the Commodity Credit Corporation must name a loan of your farm or farm rental that was forfeited in 2026 and whose principal equals box 2.
Revision.Target: 对于以作物抵偿商品信贷公司贷款的表格 1099-A，必须指定您农场或农场出租业务中一笔在 2026 年以抵押物抵偿的贷款，且其本金必须等于第 2 栏金额。

Revision.Source: A Form 3800 current or carried credit with a section 1341 repayment needs a combined tax comparison.
Revision.Target: 表格 3800 的本年或结转抵免与第 1341 条规定的偿还款并存时，需要进行合并税额比较。

Revision.Source: A Form 8915-F from 2023 or earlier has no 2026 income; a 2026 repayment of those distributions is carried back to 2023-2025 on amended returns (Form 1040-X, Form 8915-F lines 14 and 25), which this App does not prepare.
Revision.Target: 2023 年或更早年度的表格 8915-F 不产生 2026 年收入；2026 年偿还这些分配款项的金额应通过修正申报表向前结转至 2023—2025 年（表格 1040-X、表格 8915-F 第 14 行和第 25 行），本应用不编制这些修正申报表。

Revision.Source: A home first used for business before May 13, 1993 needs the Pub 946 depreciation percentage (Form 8829 line 41) and is not calculated.
Revision.Target: 首次用于营业的日期早于 1993 年 5 月 13 日的住宅，需要使用第 946 号出版物中的折旧百分比（表格 8829 第 41 行）；本应用不计算此项。

Revision.Source: A K-1 box 12 code A adjustment with a current or prior regular/AMT net operating loss needs its source-character and loss-absorption worksheets.
Revision.Target: K-1 第 12 栏代码 A 调整与本年或以前年度的常规税／AMT 净经营亏损并存时，需要编制其来源性质及亏损抵用工作表。

Revision.Source: A K-1 box 12 code B qualified-dividend adjustment with a Form 4952 investment-interest election or Form 2555 exclusion needs coordinated AMT preferential-rate worksheets.
Revision.Target: K-1 第 12 栏代码 B 合格股息调整与表格 4952 投资利息选择或表格 2555 免税额并存时，需要统筹编制 AMT 优惠税率工作表。

Revision.Source: A K-1 box 12 code C short-term gain adjustment with Form 4952 investment interest or Form 2555 exclusion needs coordinated AMT rate worksheets.
Revision.Target: K-1 第 12 栏代码 C 短期收益调整与表格 4952 投资利息或表格 2555 免税额并存时，需要统筹编制 AMT 税率工作表。

Revision.Source: A K-1 box 12 code D long-term gain adjustment with Form 4952 investment interest or Form 2555 exclusion needs coordinated AMT rate worksheets.
Revision.Target: K-1 第 12 栏代码 D 长期收益调整与表格 4952 投资利息或表格 2555 免税额并存时，需要统筹编制 AMT 税率工作表。

Revision.Source: A K-1 box 12 code E section 1250 adjustment with Form 4952 investment interest or Form 2555 exclusion needs coordinated AMT special-rate worksheets.
Revision.Target: K-1 第 12 栏代码 E 的第 1250 条调整与表格 4952 投资利息或表格 2555 免税额并存时，需要统筹编制 AMT 特殊税率工作表。

Revision.Source: A long-term-care premium names someone who is not on this return. Choose the insured person from the people on the return.
Revision.Target: 一笔长期护理保险费所指定的人员不在本申报表中。请选择本申报表中的人员作为被保险人。

Revision.Source: A main home foreclosure with a gain is entered on the Sale of your main home page, with the amount realized shown here as its price, so the home-sale exclusion applies (section 121; Pub. 4681).
Revision.Target: 主要住宅被止赎且产生收益时，应在“出售主要住宅”页面录入，并将此处显示的变现金额作为售价，以便适用住宅出售收益免税规定（第 121 条；第 4681 号出版物）。

Revision.Source: A mixed asset's income must match a unique passive foreign-income source.
Revision.Target: 混合资产的收入必须对应唯一一个被动境外收入来源。

Revision.Source: A mixed-source asset needs a positive current-year gross-income yield to characterize its basis; unresolved or zero yield requires a separate worksheet.
Revision.Target: 混合来源资产需要正数的本年总收入收益，才能确定其计税基础的性质归属；收益未确定或为零时，需要另行编制工作表。

Revision.Source: A month combining a policy with an allocated benchmark and another policy needs each coverage family's benchmark (Form 8962 Part IV column (f), lines 12 to 23 column (b)).
Revision.Target: 同一个月内，若同时有一份基准保费经分配的保单和另一份保单，则需要每个参保家庭的基准保费（表格 8962 第 IV 部分 (f) 栏、第 12 至 23 行的 (b) 栏）。

Revision.Source: A negative Form 8978 adjustment beyond Form 1040 line 18 with MSA, ABLE, Trump-account earnings, mortgage-subsidy or education-credit additional tax needs a separate Chapter 1 Schedule 2 Part II classification. Only verified early-distribution and section 223 HSA additional taxes can currently absorb that excess; section 4973 HSA excess-contribution excise cannot.
Revision.Target: 表格 8978 的负数调整绝对值超过表格 1040 第 18 行金额，且涉及 MSA、ABLE、Trump 账户收益、住房贷款补贴或教育抵免附加税时，需要另行对附表 2 第 II 部分的税款进行第 1 章归类。目前只有经核实的提前分配附加税及第 223 条 HSA 附加税可用于抵减该超出部分；第 4973 条 HSA 超额缴款消费税不可用于抵减。

Revision.Source: A nonqualified annuity needs a payer-determined amount or supported annuity calculation, and ordinary, early-without-exception, death, permanent-disability or immediate-annuity treatment. Other basis methods, exchanges outside the direct-exchange calculation, repayments and other section 72(q) exceptions need additional worksheets.
Revision.Target: 非合格年金需要付款方确定的金额或本应用支持的年金计算，并按普通领取、无例外豁免的提前领取、死亡、永久残疾或即期年金规则处理。其他计税基础方法、直接交换计算范围以外的交换、偿还款以及第72(q)条规定的其他例外情形，需要额外的计算工作表。

Revision.Source: A partial exception needs a traditional IRA allocation, the qualified pre-annuity withdrawal worksheet, or a complete qualified employer-plan discharge. Other non-IRA basis methods and overlapping public-safety premium exclusions need source-specific allocation.
Revision.Target: 部分例外豁免需要传统IRA分配计算、合格年金开始领取前提款计算工作表，或符合条件的雇主计划全额结清。其他非IRA计税基础方法以及相互重叠的公共安全人员保费免税额，需要按具体来源分配。

Revision.Source: A passenger automobile's section 179 election cannot exceed its first-year depreciation limit on the business-use share, and an income-limited section 179 carryforward on a passenger automobile is not calculated (Form 4562 line 26(i)).
Revision.Target: 乘用车选择按第179条扣除的金额，不得超过其业务使用部分的首年折旧限额；本应用不计算乘用车因收入限制而产生的第179条结转额（表格4562第26(i)行）。

Revision.Source: A personally used road vehicle needs the required timely Form 1098-C or equivalent acknowledgment certifying its charity treatment. An unrelated sale uses the smaller of FMV and proceeds when proceeds exceed $500, or the smaller of FMV and $500 otherwise. Significant use, material improvement or needy-person transfer can use FMV; when similar road-vehicle claims exceed $5,000 together before income limits, each FMV-based exception vehicle needs a qualified appraisal and complete Form 8283 Section B evidence for its donee. Gross-proceeds-limited vehicles stay in Section A. Business use, appreciated basis or duplicated benefits need another worksheet.
Revision.Target: 捐赠个人使用的道路车辆，必须及时取得规定的表格1098-C或同等确认函，以证明车辆的慈善用途处理方式。若出售给无关联方，出售所得超过$500时，采用公允市场价值与出售所得中的较低者；否则采用公允市场价值与$500中的较低者。慈善机构大量使用、实质性改良或转让给困难人士的车辆，可采用公允市场价值；若同类道路车辆在应用收入限制前的申报扣除额合计超过$5,000，则每辆按公允市场价值适用例外的车辆，均须有合格评估以及针对其受赠方的完整表格8283 B部分证明材料。扣除额受出售总收入限制的车辆仍填入A部分。业务使用、计税基础增值或重复税收优惠，需要另用计算工作表。

Revision.Source: A positive 2025 50%-class household-furnishing carry means the original public-charity 50% room was exhausted before any 30%-class stock deduction. The paired single-stock 2025 carry must therefore equal its full original fair market value. Reconcile both amounts against the same filed 2025 class-limit worksheet.
Revision.Target: 2025年50%限额类别的家居用品捐赠结转额为正，意味着在扣除任何30%限额类别股票捐赠之前，原先向公共慈善机构捐赠的50%限额空间已用尽。因此，与之配对的2025年单笔股票捐赠结转额必须等于其原始公允市场价值全额。请依据同一份已申报的2025年分类限额计算工作表核对这两个金额。

Revision.Source: A positive withholding rate requires paid eligible tax; review the payment record and credit eligibility.
Revision.Target: 预扣税率大于零时，必须有实际缴纳且符合抵免条件的税款；请核查付款记录和抵免资格。

Revision.Source: A prior 30%-class public-stock carryover with a prior cash or other unsupported carryover class, current 30%-class student or whaling expense, or a 2026 capital-gain-property basis election needs a separate coordinated worksheet. One documented 2025 household-furnishing 50%-class carryover may be entered with this balance when the original-year combined worksheet is reconciled.
Revision.Target: 以前年度30%限额类别的上市股票捐赠结转额，如同时存在以前年度现金捐赠或其他不受支持类别的结转额、本年度30%限额类别的学生寄宿或捕鲸费用，或2026年资本利得财产计税基础选择，则需要单独的协调计算工作表。若已核对原始年度的合并计算工作表，可将一笔有证明材料的2025年50%限额类别家居用品捐赠结转额与此余额一并录入。

Revision.Source: A prior cash carryover with regular or AMT operating losses or Form 1116 needs a coordinated carryover worksheet.
Revision.Target: 以前年度现金捐赠结转额如同时涉及常规税或替代性最低税（AMT）的经营亏损，或表格1116，则需要协调结转计算工作表。

Revision.Source: A prior public-stock carryover with regular or AMT operating losses or Form 1116 requires a coordinated carryover worksheet.
Revision.Target: 以前年度上市股票捐赠结转额如同时涉及常规税或替代性最低税（AMT）的经营亏损，或表格1116，则需要协调结转计算工作表。

Revision.Source: A prior regular NOL and section 1202 exclusion need further Form 172 Part II line 6 worksheets when a changed traditional IRA deduction also affects a same-year IRA distribution or QCD, an employer adoption-benefit exclusion changes, or the passive activity result changes under restored gain.
Revision.Target: 以前年度常规税净经营亏损（NOL）与第1202条免税额同时存在时，如传统IRA扣除额的变动还影响同年IRA领取款或合格慈善分配（QCD）、雇主收养福利免税额发生变化，或加回收益后被动活动结果发生变化，则需要额外的表格172第II部分第6行计算工作表。

Revision.Source: A prior regular NOL and section 1202 exclusion with prior charitable carryovers, noncash, hosted-student or whaling expenses needs further Form 172 Part II modified-income worksheets. Current cash gifts, including percentage-limit excess, are supported.
Revision.Target: 以前年度常规税净经营亏损（NOL）与第1202条免税额同时存在，且涉及以前年度慈善捐赠结转额、非现金捐赠、学生寄宿或捕鲸费用时，需要额外的表格172第II部分修正收入计算工作表。本应用支持本年度现金捐赠，包括超过百分比限额的部分。

Revision.Source: A prior suspended passive loss for a property now treated as nonpassive under the real-estate-professional election needs its own release calculation before an estimate.
Revision.Target: 某项房产现因房地产专业人士税务选择而按非被动活动处理时，其以前年度暂不准扣除的被动亏损，须先单独计算可解除限制的金额，才能进行估算。

Revision.Source: A 2025 foreign-tax deduction or no-Form-1116 small-credit election cannot generate unused 2025 foreign taxes. Reconcile the origin year and prior election; older surviving balances retain their original years.
Revision.Target: 2025年选择外国税扣除，或选择无需表格1116的小额抵免，均不能产生2025年未使用外国税额。请核对产生年度及以前所作的选择；更早年度仍可使用的余额保留其原始年度。

Revision.Source: A qualified real-estate professional needs the confirmed Pub 925 more-than-half and 750-hour tests before rental losses can be nonpassive.

New vehicles need more than 50% business use for section 179; a heavy passenger SUV without a design exception has a $32,000 election limit. Continuing passenger automobiles need a supported original schedule and annual cap history; unsupported changed-use, carryforward, lease and employer-provided cases need their own rules (Form 4562 Part V).
Revision.Target: 请确认该车辆为自有、按5年折旧的车辆，在Schedule C或Schedule F中采用实际费用法，并确认其实际车型设计。新投入使用的车辆，其经营用途比例须超过50%才能适用第179条；不符合车型设计例外的重型乘用SUV，选择费用化的限额为32,000美元。以前年度已投入使用的乘用汽车需要有依据的原始折旧明细和历年限额记录；不受支持的用途变更、结转、租赁及雇主提供车辆情形，需要按各自规则处理（Form 4562第V部分）。

Revision.Source: Confirm a commercial annuity withdrawal or newly taxable loan/pledge before annuity payments begin, with ordinary earnings-first treatment and complete pre-withdrawal contract records. Include all required related contracts with reconciled balances before this payment. Full surrender, exchange, legacy investment and unresolved grouping need separate calculations.
Revision.Target: 请确认这是年金开始定期支付前的商业年金提款，或新产生应税义务的贷款或质押，适用通常的收益优先处理，并具备提款前的完整合同记录。在本次付款前，请纳入所有按规定应合并处理的相关合同，并核对其余额。全部退保、交换、适用旧规则的投入金额及尚未明确的合同分组，需要单独计算。

Revision.Source: Confirm a complete cash discharge of this pension or commercial annuity contract with remaining investment reconciled. Partial payments, IRA/Roth, exchange, NUA, special elections and final-annuitant death deductions use other treatments.
Revision.Target: 请确认该养老金或商业年金合同已以现金完全结清，且剩余投入金额已核对一致。部分付款、IRA/Roth、交换、NUA、特殊选择以及最后一位年金领取人去世时的扣除，适用其他处理方式。

Revision.Source: Confirm a complete timely Archer MSA correction, its contribution year, deadline and known employer wage reporting. Late or incomplete corrections need separate treatment.
Revision.Target: 请确认Archer MSA已按时完成全部更正，并确认其缴款年度、截止日期及已知的雇主工资申报情况。逾期或不完整的更正需单独处理。

Revision.Source: An HSA excess-contribution return made after its correction deadline needs separate treatment.
Revision.Target: HSA超额缴款在更正截止日期之后退还的，需单独处理。

Revision.Source: Confirm a direct section 1041 transfer to a spouse or former spouse incident to divorce with no recognized gain or loss; other transfers require Form 8828 review.
Revision.Target: 请确认这是依据第1041条向配偶或因离婚向前配偶进行的直接转移，且不确认收益或损失；其他转移需要审查Form 8828。

Revision.Source: Confirm a direct transfer from an employer plan to a qualified employee plan or 403(b) with separate taxable and after-tax accounting. IRA sources and indirect transfers cannot use this destination.
Revision.Target: 请确认这是从雇主计划直接转移至合格雇员计划或403(b)计划，并对应税金额和税后金额分别核算。来源为IRA的资金及间接转移不能使用此转入目标。

Revision.Source: Confirm a final 2026 Form 1041 and that this beneficiary succeeds to the estate's or trust's property before claiming box 11 codes A through F.
Revision.Target: 申报第11栏代码A至F项下金额前，请确认2026年度Form 1041为最终税表，且该受益人承继了遗产或信托的财产。

Revision.Source: Confirm a first reissue, the original certificate and its 2026 limit interest, and that the reissue went to the same holders for the same home, replaced the original entirely, and retained no old certified debt. A variable-rate original needs a retained scheduled- or hypothetical-interest worksheet with confirmed consistent use of that method; multiple refinancings need separate history.
Revision.Target: 请确认这是首次重新签发，核实原证书及其2026年度限额所用利息，并确认新证书签发给相同持有人、对应同一住房、完全替代原证书，且未保留任何原获认证债务。如果原贷款采用浮动利率，需保留按计划利息或假设利息计算的计算表，并确认始终采用同一方法；多次再融资需要单独的历史记录。

Revision.Source: Confirm a full direct transfer of this 17-year-old beneficiary's own Trump account to their eligible ABLE account in 2026, and resolve any excess contributions before transfer. Partial, indirect or mismatched transfers require separate treatment.
Revision.Target: 请确认在2026年将这名17岁受益人本人的Trump账户全额直接转入其符合条件的ABLE账户，并在转移前处理所有超额缴款。部分转移、间接转移或信息不匹配的转移需单独处理。

Revision.Source: Confirm a living original designated beneficiary and owner death before 2026. Successor/trust rules, other spouse elections and unresolved source allocations need the administrator's minimum.
Revision.Target: 请确认原指定受益人仍在世，且账户所有人于2026年之前去世。涉及后续受益人或信托规则、其他配偶选择或尚未明确的来源分摊时，需要采用管理人提供的最低分配额。

Revision.Source: Confirm a participating qualified defined-contribution plan and the issuer's certified annual premium statement filed before payment. IRA and ordinary retroactively designated withdrawals do not qualify.
Revision.Target: 请确认这是参与该安排的合格固定缴款计划，且发行方经认证的年度保费报表已在付款前提交。IRA提款及事后追溯指定用途的普通提款不符合条件。

Revision.Source: Confirm a qualified distribution during eligible reserve duty, an order for at least 180 days or indefinitely, and actual traditional IRA repayments after release and within two years. All repayments together cannot exceed that original distribution.
Revision.Target: 请确认分配发生在符合条件的预备役服役期间且符合规定，征召令期限至少为180天或无固定期限，并且已在退役后两年内实际向传统IRA偿还。所有偿还额合计不得超过原始分配额。

Revision.Source: Confirm a qualified subordinate mortgage-loan governmental lender was actually paid at or after the sale, the HomeSale expenses exclude this payment, and the paid share does not exceed the sale gain.
Revision.Target: 请确认已在出售时或出售后实际向合格次级抵押贷款的政府贷款方付款，HomeSale费用未包含该笔付款，且已支付部分不超过出售收益。

Revision.Source: Confirm a simplified limitation election made for the first post-1997 AMT foreign-credit claim year and still in force. A later first election or unconfirmed history cannot be assumed.
Revision.Target: 请确认已在1997年后首次申领AMT外国税收抵免的年度选择简化限额方法，且该选择仍有效。不能假定首次选择是在以后年度作出的，也不能假定尚未确认的历史情况。

Revision.Source: Confirm box 12 code A either stands alone or exactly equals the sum of its signed code B qualified-dividend, C short-term and D long-term components. Every nonzero component must have A's sign; confirmed codes E/F are disjoint same-sign portions of D, not additional AMTI. Other box 12 codes, missing or contradictory fiduciary attribution, related AMT items and Form 1116 foreign tax credits need separate worksheets.
Revision.Target: 请确认第12栏代码A项下金额为独立金额，或恰好等于其带正负号的代码B合格股息、代码C短期及代码D长期组成金额之和。每个非零组成金额的正负号必须与A一致；经确认的代码E/F是D中互不重叠且同号的部分，不是额外的替代性最低应税收入（AMTI）。其他第12栏代码、缺失或相互矛盾的受托人归属信息、相关AMT项目以及Form 1116外国税收抵免，均需使用单独的计算表。

Revision.Source: The repayment comparison needs more than $3,000 of earlier-year unemployment or railroad repayments. Net Social Security repayments need their own prior-taxability calculation.
Revision.Target: 只有偿还以前年度的失业救济金或铁路退休福利超过 $3,000，才能进行偿还额比较计算。社会保障福利的净偿还额需要单独计算其以前的应税部分。

Revision.Source: Enter valid portfolio basis records and unique foreign-income labels before allocating investment interest.
Revision.Target: 分摊投资利息前，请输入有效的投资组合计税基础记录，并为各项境外收入使用不重复的标签。

Revision.Source: Confirm complete own-IRA balances and source facts; use the inherited branch for supported beneficiary accounts or an administrator's minimum for annuity and unresolved special-relief cases.
Revision.Target: 请确认本人 IRA 的余额和来源信息完整；对于受支持的受益人账户，请使用继承账户选项；对于年金及尚未解决的特殊减免情形，请使用管理机构提供的最低提取额。

Revision.Source: Confirm complete payroll records and one eligible employer record per filer; unresolved payroll exceptions need their own treatment.
Revision.Target: 请确认工资记录完整，且每位申报人有一条符合条件的雇主记录；尚未解决的工资例外情形需要单独处理。

Revision.Source: Enter each category of the 2025 credit or hypothetical deduction-year worksheets once before allocating excess taxes.
Revision.Target: 分摊超额税款前，请逐类输入 2025 年税收抵免计算表或假设采用扣除的年度计算表中的数据，每类仅输入一次。

Revision.Source: Enter each category's retained regular and AMT loss accounts once, with at most one separate limitation loss balance per tax system.
Revision.Target: 请逐类输入所保留的一般税和替代性最低税（AMT）亏损账户记录，每类仅输入一次；每种税制下最多只能有一笔单独限额亏损余额。

Revision.Source: Confirm complete section 195 start-up costs, the original deduction/capitalization election and an active business begun after October 22, 2004 and continuing through 2026. Disposition, missing prior deductions or other special treatment needs its own calculation.
Revision.Target: 请确认第 195 条规定的开办费用完整、最初的扣除或资本化选择无误，且业务于 2004 年 10 月 22 日之后开始实际经营并持续至 2026 年。处置、遗漏以前年度扣除或其他特殊处理情形需要单独计算。

Revision.Source: Confirm complete state records, unique foreign-source labels and payments matching the itemized income-tax amount exactly.
Revision.Target: 请确认州税记录完整、各项境外来源标签不重复，且缴纳的税款与分项扣除的所得税金额完全一致。

Revision.Source: Confirm disjoint corrected W-2 code T sources, qualified plans and a joint return for domestic children; benefits for a foreign child paid to both spouses, and foreign benefits taxed before finalization, are not calculated. Deemed line 29 excess reduces joint line 1f, not either employee's earnings.
Revision.Target: 请确认更正后的 W-2 表代码 T 来源互不重叠、计划符合条件，且涉及美国境内儿童时采用夫妻联合申报；不计算向夫妻双方支付的外国儿童收养福利，以及在收养最终确定前已征税的外国儿童收养福利。第 29 行的视同超额金额应减少联合申报的第 1f 行金额，而非任何一方雇员的收入。

Revision.Source: Whaling captain expenses can be claimed only by a captain on this return: your spouse's expenses need a joint return. A whaling expense can be claimed only as an itemized contribution.
Revision.Target: 只有列于本申报表中的捕鲸船长才能申报其费用：如需申报配偶的费用，必须采用夫妻联合申报。捕鲸费用只能作为捐赠进行分项扣除。

Revision.Source: Confirm each distinct IRA account's complete 2026-designated contribution and all attributable net income or loss were corrected by the 2027 filing deadline, with an eligible extension if needed. A late return, another contribution year, or multiple corrections in one account needs separate treatment.
Revision.Target: 请确认每个独立 IRA 账户中指定归属 2026 年的全部缴款及其所有应归属净收益或净亏损，均已在 2027 年报税截止日期前完成更正；如有需要，应取得符合条件的延期。逾期退回缴款、涉及其他缴款年度或同一账户多次更正的情形需要单独处理。

Revision.Source: Enter valid housing expenses, allowances, household amounts and 2026 stay dates.
Revision.Target: 请输入有效的住房费用、津贴、家庭相关金额及 2026 年居留日期。

Revision.Source: Confirm every direct 2026 trustee transfer for the same beneficiary, each 529 account's 15-year history and administrator-reconciled five-year seasoned source amount after earlier distributions, and $35,000 lifetime room across all 529 accounts.
Revision.Target: 请确认同一受益人在 2026 年发生的每笔受托人直接转账、每个 529 账户的 15 年历史、经管理机构核对且扣除此前分配后已存满五年的来源金额，以及所有 529 账户合计 $35,000 终身限额的剩余额度。

Revision.Source: Confirm FLSA-required overtime above the regular rate, separately reported on a 2026 Form 1099-NEC or 1099-MISC and included once in this U.S. Schedule C business's ordinary receipts. Other payment and source cases require their own worksheet.
Revision.Target: 请确认加班报酬中超过正常工资率的部分为《公平劳动标准法》（FLSA）所要求，已在 2026 年 1099-NEC 或 1099-MISC 表中单独列报，且已计入此项美国附表 C 业务的日常营业收入，仅计入一次。其他付款或来源情形需要使用各自的计算表。

Revision.Source: Confirm one consistently adopted eligible poultry-cost method. An uncertain, income-distorting or changed method needs its own accounting worksheet; neither the supply exception nor this editor elects a new method.
Revision.Target: 请确认始终采用同一种符合条件的家禽成本核算方法。方法不明确、导致收入失真或发生变更的情形需要单独的会计计算表；用品费用例外规则和此编辑界面均不会替您选择新的核算方法。

Revision.Source: Confirm one employee's written 2025 calendar-year grace balance and current ordinary W-2 box 10 from the same plan, the service and reimbursement dates, and all distinct qualified care. Unmatched W-2, second plans, forfeiture, prior-year taxable wages or separate-return worksheets need review.
Revision.Target: 请确认同一雇员在同一计划下有书面记录的 2025 日历年度宽限期余额及本年度常规 W-2 表第 10 栏金额、服务与报销日期，以及所有互不重复的合格照护支出。W-2 表不匹配、存在第二项计划、余额被没收、以前年度应税工资或夫妻分开申报计算表等情形需要复核。

Revision.Source: Confirm ordinary age-60-or-later RRB pension treatment or documented survivor payments after death. Unresolved repayments, disability-wage routing, unresolved shared employee contributions and other adjustments require additional worksheets.
Revision.Target: 请确认适用 60 岁或以后领取 RRB 养老金的常规处理方式，或属于有凭证的死亡后遗属给付。尚未解决的偿还款、残疾给付计入工资的归类问题、尚未明确分配的共同雇员缴款及其他调整，需要额外计算表。

Revision.Source: An original-year retirement taxable amount cannot exceed its gross distribution.
Revision.Target: 原年度退休金的应税金额不得超过其分配总额。

Revision.Source: Confirm ordinary own-account withdrawals and source dates. Inherited, special repayment, rollover, unentered HSA funding and unlisted exception cases require further support.
Revision.Target: 请确认本人账户的常规提取款及来源日期。继承账户、特殊偿还、转存、尚未录入的 HSA 注资及未列出的例外情形，需要进一步的支持资料。

Revision.Source: Confirm ordinary own-account withdrawals for an owner present on this return.
Revision.Target: 请确认这些是本申报表所列账户所有人从本人账户提取的常规款项。

Revision.Source: Alimony under an instrument executed before 1985 follows special rules that are not calculated.
Revision.Target: 根据 1985 年之前签署的法律文书支付的离婚赡养费适用特殊规则，此处不予计算。

Revision.Source: Confirm ordinary wholly foreign services subject to U.S. SE tax, without special foreign treatment. Mixed sources, capital-producing activities and foreign property/vehicle/home-office deductions need their additional source and depreciation worksheets.
Revision.Target: 请确认服务全部在境外提供，按常规缴纳美国自雇税，且不适用特殊境外税务处理。境内外混合来源、依靠资本产生收入的活动，以及境外财产、车辆或家庭办公室扣除，需要额外的来源和折旧计算表。

Revision.Source: Medical expenses on the original Form 5329 require a selected medical-exception distribution.
Revision.Target: 如原始 5329 表中列有医疗费用，必须选择一项适用医疗费用豁免的分配款。

Revision.Source: Confirm paid federal estate tax, the estate-wide recomputation and gross IRD denominator, and this beneficiary's unused allocation. A shared QCD cap or deductible-contribution adjustment across several sources needs an explicit source allocation before this deduction can be determined.
Revision.Target: 请确认已缴纳的联邦遗产税、针对全部遗产的重新计算、用作分母的被继承人应计收入（IRD）总额，以及此受益人尚未使用的分摊额。如果多个来源共用合格慈善分配（QCD）限额或可扣除缴款调整，必须先明确分摊到各来源，才能确定此项扣除。

Revision.Source: Confirm post-July 1, 1986 annuitization, death of the linked final annuitant, ordinary or inherited periodic pension/annuity treatment and complete nonduplicated investment recovery. Payments must cease because of death, not expiration of a fixed period independent of life. Starting date, original net investment and prior recovery must agree with the linked worksheet. A temporary child annuity must end in the death month and agree with the deduction records.
Revision.Target: 请确认年金化始于 1986 年 7 月 1 日之后、关联的最后一位年金领取人已死亡、适用常规或继承的定期养老金或年金处理方式，且投资成本收回记录完整、无重复。给付必须因死亡而终止，不能是因与寿命无关的固定期限届满而终止。起始日期、原始净投资额及此前收回额必须与关联计算表一致。临时子女年金必须在死亡当月终止，并与扣除记录一致。

Revision.Source: Confirm pre-August 14, 1982 contract issuance and the insurer's separate old/new investment and earnings records. Loans, pledges, surrenders, exchanges, losses within a portion and unresolved allocations require further calculations.
Revision.Target: 请确认合同签发于 1982 年 8 月 14 日之前，且保险公司分别保留了新旧投资及收益记录。贷款、质押、退保、交换、某一部分内的亏损及尚未解决的分摊问题需要进一步计算。

Revision.Source: Reconcile the prior return's expense base and excluded/deducted benefits; unresolved history needs review.
Revision.Target: 请核对以前年度申报表的费用基数，以及已从收入中排除或已扣除的福利；尚未厘清的历史记录需要复核。

Revision.Source: Confirm professional gambling. Mixed casual/professional or multiple wagering activities, inventory, home-office and owner health/retirement coordination need additional worksheets.
Revision.Target: 请确认属于职业赌博。兼有业余与职业赌博、从事多项博彩活动、涉及存货、家庭办公室，以及业主医疗或退休项目的统筹处理，均需要额外计算表。

Revision.Source: Confirm qualified coverage, eligible family relationship, medical eligibility and each month's employer long-term-care eligibility.
Revision.Target: 请确认保险保障、家庭关系及医疗资格均符合条件，并确认每个月参加雇主长期护理计划的资格。

Revision.Source: Confirm qualified customer tips separately stated on 2026 information returns furnished to this individual, included once in U.S. Schedule C ordinary receipts or Schedule F other farm operating receipts. Partnership and unresolved source cases require their own worksheet.
Revision.Target: 请确认合格顾客小费已在提供给此人的 2026 年信息申报表中单独列明，且已计入美国附表 C 的日常营业收入或附表 F 的其他农场经营收入，仅计入一次。合伙企业及尚未解决的来源情形需要使用各自的计算表。

Revision.Source: Confirm qualifying purchased equipment with the entered service date, first-year election or complete continuing history with identical regular/AMT basis or the separately recorded required AMT schedule. A first-use 2026 asset acquired before September 28, 2017 receives no bonus; ordinary 200% GDS for a 3-, 5-, 7-, or 10-year class uses the same basis, recovery period, and convention with 150% for AMT. Continuing earlier purchases require post-1998 service and 150%/straight-line GDS or a supported separate 200%/150% history. Unrecovered basis after the recovery period or an unsupported history needs its separate worksheet.
Revision.Target: 请确认购入设备符合条件、投入使用日期已录入，并已提供首年税务选择，或完整的后续年度历史记录；一般税与替代性最低税（AMT）的计税基础须相同，否则须单独记录所需的 AMT 折旧表。2017 年 9 月 28 日之前购入、于 2026 年首次使用的资产不适用额外首年折旧；对于 3 年、5 年、7 年或 10 年类别，常规 200% 一般折旧制度（GDS）与 AMT 使用相同的计税基础、折旧年限及折旧惯例，但 AMT 使用 150% 折旧率。以前购入并继续折旧的资产必须在 1998 年之后投入使用，且采用 150% 或直线法 GDS，或有受支持的独立 200%/150% 折旧历史。折旧期结束后仍未收回的计税基础或不受支持的历史记录，需要单独的计算表。

Revision.Source: Confirm qualifying purchased rental equipment, 100% income-producing use, no section 179 election or carryforward, and complete depreciation records. Listed property, vehicles, ADS, changed use and other basis treatment need separate worksheets.
Revision.Target: 请确认购入的出租设备符合条件、100% 用于产生收入、没有第 179 条扣除选择或结转额，且折旧记录完整。列管财产、车辆、替代折旧制度（ADS）、用途变更及其他计税基础处理情形需要单独的计算表。

Revision.Source: Confirm ten years of qualifying use, a qualified individual buyer, an enforceable ten-year covenant and a recognized gain before electing section 1062.
Revision.Target: 选择适用第 1062 条前，请确认已有十年符合条件的使用、买方为符合条件的个人、存在具有法律约束力的十年契约，且有已确认收益。

Revision.Source: Confirm the 2025 employer plan's written calendar-year grace period, its unused balance, the 2026 service and reimbursement dates, this employee's ownership, and all distinct qualified expenses. Revision.Source: Confirm the K-1 box 20 code C fuel quantities, use, applicable rate, partner-share cost and no earlier Form 8849/8864/720 claim. Farm-operator fuel lines require an established farm activity; a custom aerial applicator may claim its own farm-use aviation gasoline or kerosene without operating the farm, with an unwaived kerosene claim; public-bus diesel/kerosene and foreign-trade aviation kerosene need unwaived claims; foreign-trade aviation gasoline needs civil-aircraft trade and reciprocity for foreign registry; exports need retained proof, and a blender claim needs the partnership's M registration and certification. Registered-vendor government diesel line 6a and nonaviation-kerosene line 7a require distinct seller UV registration, buyer certificates, sale records, tax relief and no government-issued credit card. Blocked-pump kerosene line 7b requires the partnership seller's UP registration, qualifying fixed and marked pump, nontaxable buyer use, and buyer records for locked-pump sales over five gallons. Registered-vendor bus lines 6b and 7c require the partnership seller's UB registration, current buyer waivers, qualifying public-bus service and distinct sale records. Commercial-aviation kerosene vendor lines 8a and 8b require the partnership seller's UA registration, current signed Model Waiver L, separate original-tax-rate sales, and buyer and cost records. Nonexempt noncommercial aviation line 8c requires its separate UA vendor claim, 24.4-cent original tax, current signed Model Certificate Q, distinct sale and cost records, and no duplicated gallons. Nontaxable noncommercial aviation lines 8d/8e need the original tax rate, eligible use, current Model Waiver L with UA registration or Model Certificate P with UV registration for government sales, and distinct sale and cost records; foreign-trade gallons also generate line 8f LUST credit. A registered card issuer on line 13 needs its own active CC registration, government-issued credit-card purchase, current signed Model Certificate R, buyer tax relief, vendor settlement, actual cost, and no duplicate Form 720/8849 claim; only the partner share from box 20 code C belongs here. Retained buyer tax requires partnership-level income and K-1 accounting and is not supported on this partner path. A prior-year credit producing current Schedule E income belongs in the separate prior-credit field.
Revision.Target: 请确认K-1第20栏代码C的燃料数量、用途、适用税率及合伙人应分摊的成本，并确认此前未通过表格8849、8864或720申领。农场经营者燃料项目要求已有农场经营活动；提供定制航空施用服务的经营者即使不经营农场，也可就其自用的农用航空汽油或煤油申领，但煤油申领权不得已被放弃；公共巴士柴油或煤油以及外贸航空煤油要求申领权未被放弃；外贸航空汽油要求用于民用航空器外贸运输，外国注册航空器还须满足互惠条件；出口需保留证明，调和商申领则需合伙企业的M类登记及证明文件。注册销售商的政府用柴油第6a行及非航空用煤油第7a行，要求销售商具备单独的UV类登记、买方证明、销售记录、税收减免资格，且未使用政府发行的信用卡。受限泵煤油第7b行要求合伙企业销售商具备UP类登记、使用符合资格且有标识的固定加油泵、买方用途免税，并对通过上锁加油泵销售超过五加仑的交易保留买方记录。注册销售商的巴士用燃料第6b行及第7c行，要求合伙企业销售商具备UB类登记、现行有效的买方放弃申领权声明、符合资格的公共巴士服务及单独的销售记录。商业航空煤油销售商第8a行及第8b行，要求合伙企业销售商具备UA类登记、现行有效且已签署的L型放弃申领权声明、按原始税率分别记录的销售，以及买方和成本记录。非免税非商业航空第8c行要求单独按UA类销售商身份申领、原征税额为每加仑24.4美分、持有现行有效且已签署的Q型证明、单独的销售及成本记录，且加仑数不得重复申报。免税非商业航空第8d/8e行需要原始税率、符合资格的用途、现行有效的L型放弃申领权声明及UA类登记，或政府销售所需的P型证明及UV类登记，并需单独的销售及成本记录；外贸用途的加仑数还可产生第8f行地下储油罐泄漏（LUST）税抵免。第13行的注册发卡机构需持有自身有效的CC类登记，交易须使用政府发行的信用卡，并需具备现行有效且已签署的R型证明、买方税收减免资格、与销售商的结算记录、实际成本，且不得通过表格720或8849重复申领；此处仅应计入第20栏代码C中合伙人应分摊的份额。保留的买方税款需要在合伙企业层面进行收入及K-1核算，此合伙人申报流程不支持该处理。产生本期附表E收入的以前年度抵免，应填入单独的以前年度抵免字段。

Registered-vendor government diesel line 6a and nonaviation-kerosene line 7a require an ordinary Schedule C seller, active UV registration, government-buyer certificate and records, tax-excluded sale, tax repayment or buyer consent, and no government-issued credit card. Blocked-pump kerosene line 7b requires an ordinary Schedule C seller, active UP registration, qualifying fixed and marked pump, nontaxable buyer use, and buyer records for locked-pump sales over five gallons. Registered-vendor bus lines 6b and 7c require an ordinary Schedule C seller, active UB registration, current buyer waivers, qualifying public-bus service and distinct sale records. Commercial-aviation kerosene vendor lines 8a and 8b require an ordinary Schedule C seller, active UA registration, current signed Model Waiver L, and separate original-tax-rate sale and cost records. Nonexempt noncommercial aviation line 8c requires an ordinary Schedule C seller, active UA registration, 24.4-cent original tax, current signed Model Certificate Q, distinct sale and cost records, and no duplicated gallons. Nontaxable noncommercial aviation lines 8d/8e require an ordinary Schedule C seller, active UA registration and current Model Waiver L, or UV registration and Model Certificate P for government sales, eligible use, original tax rate, and distinct sale and cost records; foreign-trade gallons also generate line 8f LUST credit. A registered card issuer on line 13 needs an ordinary Schedule C business, active CC registration, government-issued credit-card purchase, current signed Model Certificate R, buyer tax relief, vendor settlement, actual cost, and no duplicate Form 720/8849 claim. Retained buyer tax additionally requires a direct active issuer, exact line-13 reconciliation, no buyer/vendor profit-and-loss entries, no tax-cost deduction or duplicated credit income, and no separate cash-recovery history. An accrual issuer includes the retained benefit as 2026 Schedule C other income; a cash issuer with no 2026 receipt reviews that separate income in its actual or constructive receipt or credit-application year. Both claim the 2026 Form 4136 refundable payment once. Other fuel uses need their own worksheet.

Revision.Source: The cost-sharing improvement needs its actual taxable income, exclusion and linked property basis calculation before return totals can be shown.

Revision.Source: Mixed payment character or incomplete improvement funding needs the actual excluded cost-share funding applied to this improvement. Supply that source amount; the income-right present value does not establish the funding allocation.

Revision.Target: 本年度农民或渔民总收入资格测试，需要各收入来源所属人的完整总收入明细，以及在抵减其他来源亏损之前，已确认收益是否实际属于农业或渔业收益的资料。K-1净收入、附表K-3用于外国税计算的总收入，或先前出售记录中的经营用财产标签，均不能替代这些事实。独立确认的上年度符合农民或渔民资格的结论，可用于本年度罚款计算；独立确认的预计下一年度符合资格的结论，可用于下一年度预估税计算。

Revision.Source: Resolve the described additional farm income, timing or property source; known receipts remain included.
Revision.Target: 请核实所述的其他农场收入、确认时间或财产来源问题；已知收入仍计入。

Revision.Source: Distinct AMT farm expenses or retained supply costs need their final prepaid allowance and any dependent home-office limit. Known receipts remain; an unresolved dependent source does not establish completed tax.

Revision.Source: Current production poultry needs its actual cash-payment method, business-use start and lesser-of-12-months/useful-life allocation. Revision.Target: 本期用于生产的家禽，需要提供实际现金付款的处理方法、开始用于经营的日期，并按12个月与使用寿命中的较短期间分摊。若在月中或更早开始使用，或涉及折旧或会计方法变更，需要使用留存的原始计算表；不会推定当期费用或预付比例。

Revision.Source: Use the entity/K-1 and required accounting owner for this entity or farming syndicate.
Revision.Target: 对于此实体或农业辛迪加，请使用对应的实体/K-1记录，并由负责按规定会计方法核算的一方提供资料。

Revision.Source: Fertilizer and lime costs need their actual election or retained capital benefit recovery before the expense and remaining basis can be shown.
Revision.Target: 肥料和石灰成本需要先确定实际采用的税务选择，或留存资本化成本的收益回收情况，才能显示费用和剩余计税基础。

Revision.Source: Foreign farm income needs its actual currency, source and cross-border tax adjustments.
Revision.Target: 外国农场收入需要提供实际币种、收入来源及跨境税务调整资料。

Revision.Source: The Schedule F principal agricultural code and information-return answers are needed.
Revision.Target: 需要填写附表F的主要农业活动代码，并回答信息申报表相关问题。

Revision.Source: Resolve the complex hedge's matched income, cost character and timing.
Revision.Target: 请核实此复杂套期保值交易所匹配的收入、成本性质及确认时间。

Revision.Target: 未指定为套期保值、与存货匹配或跨年度的套期保值交易，需要由负责相关记录的一方提供实际收入性质和确认时间。仅凭已实现的金额，不能确定其属于当期普通收入，也不能确定适用投资者的60/40税务处理。

Revision.Source: Resolve the actual indirect-interest expense, capitalization and property allocation.
Revision.Target: 请核实实际间接利息费用、资本化处理及其在各项财产间的分配。

Revision.Source: An installment sale of farm land held one year or less is not calculated (Form 6252 line 26 to Form 4797 line 11).
Revision.Target: 持有一年或更短时间的农地分期付款出售不予计算（表格6252第26行转至表格4797第11行）。

Revision.Source: An installment sale of farm land with the Form 1062 tax-payment election is not calculated (Form 6252 and Form 1062 line 15).
Revision.Target: 选择按表格1062方式缴税的农地分期付款出售不予计算（表格6252及表格1062第15行）。

Revision.Source: This sale needs its accepted parcel's acquisition, regular/AMT basis and section 126 history. Unknown improvement basis or a payment after disposal cannot be omitted from required gain.

Revision.Source: Enter the sold tract's actual regular and AMT opening basis and prior conservation deductions. Revision.Source: Resolve business-property section 1231 character before business QBI.
Revision.Target: 请先确定经营用财产在第1231条下的税务性质，再计算经营活动的合格经营收入（QBI）。

Revision.Source: This sale needs its actual transaction owner for partial, related-party, exchange, special-basis or unresolved transfer facts. Required gain cannot be omitted as an unclaimed benefit.
Revision.Target: 此出售涉及部分转让、关联方交易、交换、特殊计税基础或尚未核实的转让情况，需要由实际负责该交易的一方提供资料。应确认的收益不能作为未申领的优惠而省略。

Revision.Source: Resolve this farm's actual accounting transition, consent and section 481 timing source.
Revision.Target: 请核实此农场实际的会计方法变更、批准情况，以及第481条调整确认时间的依据。

Revision.Source: Resolve the positive section 481 adjustment's AMT and consent/period facts; known receipts remain included, but required tax is unresolved.
Revision.Target: 请核实第481条正调整额的AMT处理、批准情况及适用期间；已知收入仍计入，但应纳税额尚未确定。

Revision.Source: Preproductive costs need the linked inventory or depreciable property's regular and AMT basis, release and recovery facts; a paid cost cannot be both expensed and capitalized.
Revision.Target: 生产前成本需要提供关联存货或可折旧财产的常规税及AMT计税基础，以及成本转出和回收情况；同一笔已支付成本不能既作为费用扣除又资本化。

Revision.Source: Farm product basis and inventory are already accounted for in the farm records; do not also deduct Schedule C inventory costs.
Revision.Target: 农产品计税基础和存货已在农场记录中核算；请勿再扣除附表C的存货成本。

Revision.Source: Resolve the actual disposition's basis and ownership history; required gain is not omitted with an unclaimed deduction.
Revision.Target: 请核实实际处置的计税基础及所有权历史；不能因未申领某项扣除而省略应确认的收益。

Revision.Source: Current class income from business-use livestock needs its retained Form 4797 character, basis and asset source. It cannot be omitted as an unclaimed postponement or assumed to be ordinary product income.

Revision.Source: Prior postponed income from business-use livestock needs its retained Form 4797 character and asset source. It is not ordinary product income by assumption.
Revision.Target: 以前递延的经营用牲畜收入，需要提供留存的表格4797税务性质及资产来源资料。不能假定其属于普通农产品收入。

Revision.Source: AMT sale amounts must be within the supported nonnegative money range.
Revision.Target: AMT出售金额必须在支持的非负金额范围内。

Revision.Source: AMT wash-sale loss must not exceed the AMT investment loss; personal property has no wash-sale adjustment.
Revision.Target: AMT洗售亏损不得超过AMT投资亏损；个人自用财产不适用洗售调整。
