Revision.Source: Both you and this person cannot each provide more than half the same total support.
Revision.Target: 对于同一笔总扶养费用，您和此人不可能各自都承担超过一半。

Revision.Source: Enter a valid birth date on or before December 31, 2026.
Revision.Target: 请填写有效的出生日期，且不得晚于2026年12月31日。

Revision.Source: Residence days cannot exceed days alive in 2026. Use the qualifying residency exception when the newborn rule applies.

Revision.Source: Review the document amounts; they must be within the supported input range.
Revision.Target: 请核查单据上的金额；金额必须在支持的输入范围内。

Revision.Target: 第2b栏和第2d栏中的第1250条及收藏品收益部分，不得超过第2a栏的资本利得分配总额。

Revision.Source: Specified private-activity bond interest dividends in box 13 cannot exceed exempt-interest dividends in box 12.
Revision.Target: 第13栏的指定私人活动债券利息股息，不得超过第12栏的免税利息股息。

Revision.Target: 在当前支持的处理方式下，应税退休收入不得超过对应的领取总额。

Revision.Target: 同一IRA持有人的各项首次购房申报，必须使用一致的2026年以前终身累计金额。

Revision.Source: First-year deferral is available only for the year this owner turns 73; later IRA requirements cannot be deferred for continued employment.

Revision.Source: Choose a valid 12-month presence period overlapping 2026.
Revision.Target: 请选择一个有效的12个月实际停留期间，且该期间须与2026年有重叠。

Revision.Target: 请填写有效的真实居住起止日期，结束日期须晚于开始日期。

Revision.Source: Enter the business that recovered this previously deducted expense, then select it in the tax-refund record.
Revision.Target: 请录入收回这笔以前已扣除费用的企业，然后在退税记录中选择该企业。

Revision.Source: Select the business that recovered this previously deducted expense in the tax-refund record.
Revision.Target: 请在退税记录中选择收回这笔以前已扣除费用的企业。

Revision.Target: 1099-G 表第 7 栏的农业款项需要指定接收款项的农场经营或农场出租记录：请在表中选择该所有者的一个农场。

Revision.Source: Form 1099-PATR box 9 section 199A(a) specified service trade or business items (Form 8995-A) are not calculated.

Revision.Source: Form 1099-PATR distributions need an existing farm or farm rental on this return for the same owner before they can reach Schedule F line 3a/3b or Form 4835 line 2a/2b.
Revision.Target: 要将 1099-PATR 表的分配款项计入附表 F 第 3a/3b 行或 4835 表第 2a/2b 行，本申报表中必须先有同一所有者的农场经营或农场出租记录。

Revision.Source: Form 1099-PATR distributions need the farm or farm rental that receives them: choose one of this owner's farms on the form.
Revision.Target: 1099-PATR 表的分配款项需要指定接收款项的农场经营或农场出租记录：请在表中选择该所有者的一个农场。

Revision.Source: A separate return that splits community wages cannot also claim the foreign earned income exclusion: Form 2555 figures the exclusion as if the income were not community income.

Revision.Source: Form 2555 line 44: job expenses on Form 2106 are allocable to excluded foreign earned income in part. Not calculated; remove the Form 2106 or the Form 2555.

Revision.Source: Form 3468 for business property needs an active U.S. business or farm in which you materially participate.
Revision.Target: 用于营业财产的 3468 表需要有一家正在经营且由您实质参与的美国企业或农场。

Revision.Source: Form 5884 lines 1a–1c need an active U.S. Schedule C employer whose certified employees each match one of its W-2s, with the 2026 credit wages within that W-2's Medicare wages and included in full on Schedule C line 26, a start date after January 1, 2025 for first-year wages (after January 1, 2024 for second-year wages) and before 2026, and 2025 wages within each targeted group's limit. For a completed source form outside this computation, use More credits → General business credits (Form 3800), its Form 5884 amount on line 4b.

Revision.Source: Passive credit limits use the return’s Form 8615 or Schedule J tax method, including the reduced-income comparison.
Revision.Target: 被动活动抵免限额采用本申报表的 8615 表或附表 J 计税方法，包括收入减少后的税额比较。

Revision.Source: Form 8615 lines 6 to 8: enter your parent's return, and any brother's or sister's Form 8615 that uses it, on your parent's return page.
Revision.Target: 8615 表第 6 至 8 行：请在父母申报表页面录入所用父亲或母亲的申报表，以及使用该申报表的所有兄弟姐妹的 8615 表。

Revision.Source: Form 8615 lines 9 and 15 with Schedule J on your parent's or a brother's or sister's return (on your parent's return page) are not calculated yet.
Revision.Target: 如果父亲、母亲或兄弟姐妹的申报表中有附表 J（见父母申报表页面），本应用暂不计算 8615 表第 9 和 15 行。

Revision.Source: Form 8615 lines A–C, 6 and 7: which parent's return to use, or a brother's or sister's Form 8615, is not settled on your parent's return page; the tax at your parent's rate waits for it.
Revision.Target: 8615 表第 A–C、6 和 7 行：父母申报表页面尚未确定使用父亲还是母亲的申报表，或尚未确定兄弟姐妹的 8615 表；须先确定这些信息，才能按所用父亲或母亲的税率计算税额。

Revision.Source: Form 8881 Part I Section 1 and Part II need an active U.S. Schedule C employer with employee W-2s, an eligible small employer (no more than 100 employees paid $5,000 in the prior year, no plan for substantially the same employees in the prior three years, no controlled or affiliated service group), and start-up costs included in Business expenses. The employer contributions credit (Form 8881 lines 6a–6g, which needs Schedule C line 19) and the military spouse participation credit (Part III lines 12–13) are not calculated for a business's own plan. For a completed source form outside this computation, use More credits → General business credits (Form 3800), Form 8881 lines 1j,1dd and1ee.
Revision.Target: 8881 表第一部分第 1 节及第二部分要求雇主是在美国实际经营、使用附表 C 申报且有雇员 W-2 表的企业，并属于合格小型雇主（上一年获付至少 5,000 美元的雇员不超过 100 人；过去三年未为基本相同的一批雇员设立计划；不属于受控集团或关联服务集团），且开办费用已计入“营业费用”。对于企业自设的计划，本应用不计算雇主供款抵免（8881 表第 6a–6g 行，需要附表 C 第 19 行）及军人配偶参与抵免（第三部分第 12–13 行）。对于在本计算范围之外已填写完成的原始表格，请使用“更多抵免 → 一般营业税收抵免（3800 表）”中的 8881 表第 1j、1dd 和 1ee 行。

Revision.Source: Form 8912 requires a pre-2018 qualified tax-credit or holder-credit Build America bond owned directly by a filer throughout 2026 and separately reported on its own Form 1097-BTC. Original CREBs, older QZABs, pass-throughs, nominees, combined reports, partial-year holdings and direct-pay issuer bonds need a separate review.
Revision.Target: 8912 表要求债券是 2018 年以前发行的合格税收抵免债券或向持有人提供抵免的 Build America 债券，由申报人在 2026 年全年直接持有，并以单独一份 1097-BTC 表分别申报。原始清洁可再生能源债券（CREB）、较早的合格学区债券（QZAB）、转分持有、名义持有、合并报告、非全年持有及向发行人直接付款的债券均需另行审核。

Revision.Source: Form 8915-F lines 11 and 22: one election applies to every qualified disaster distribution of the same disaster year on this filer's form. Choose the same timing on each.
Revision.Target: 8915-F 表第 11 和 22 行：同一项选择适用于该申报人表中同一灾害年度的所有合格灾害分配款项。请为每笔款项选择相同的计入收入时间安排。

Revision.Source: Form 8915-F line 1b: enter the same earlier qualified disaster distributions on every 1099-R for this disaster.
Revision.Target: 8915-F 表第 1b 行：请在此次灾害对应的每份 1099-R 表中，录入相同的以前年度合格灾害分配款项。

Revision.Source: Form 8941 needs an active U.S. Schedule C employer whose listed employees each match one of its W-2s, with the premiums you paid included in its employee benefit programs expense, and one Form 8941 per owner. Other businesses, household or leased employees, controlled groups and several rating areas are not calculated. For a completed source form outside this computation, use More credits → General business credits (Form 3800), its Form 8941 amount on line 4h.
Revision.Target: 8941 表要求雇主是在美国实际经营、使用附表 C 申报的企业，所列每名雇员均对应其一份 W-2 表，您支付的保费已计入该企业的雇员福利计划费用，且每位所有者只填一份 8941 表。本应用不计算其他企业、家政或租赁雇员、受控集团及涉及多个保费定价区域的情况。对于在本计算范围之外已填写完成的原始表格，请使用“更多抵免 → 一般营业税收抵免（3800 表）”，将其 8941 表金额填入第 4h 行。

Revision.Source: Form 8994 needs an active U.S. Schedule C employer whose listed employees each match one of its W-2s, with each employee's leave wages (and any work opportunity credit wages) within that W-2's Medicare wages, the leave wages included in its wages expense and the insurance premiums in its employee benefit programs expense, and one Form 8994 per owner. For a completed source form outside this computation, use More credits → General business credits (Form 3800), its Form 8994 amount on line 4j.
Revision.Target: 8994 表要求雇主是在美国实际经营、使用附表 C 申报的企业，所列每名雇员均对应其一份 W-2 表；每名雇员的休假工资（以及任何用于工作机会抵免的工资）不超过该 W-2 表的 Medicare 工资；休假工资已计入工资费用，保险费已计入雇员福利计划费用；且每位所有者只填一份 8994 表。对于在本计算范围之外已填写完成的原始表格，请使用“更多抵免 → 一般营业税收抵免（3800 表）”，将其 8994 表金额填入第 4j 行。

Revision.Source: Form 1116 Part II: enter at least one foreign income source, a carryover history or a foreign loss account.
Revision.Target: 1116 表第二部分：请至少录入一项外国收入来源、结转历史记录或外国亏损账户。

Revision.Source: A foreign source row names a business run abroad or an investment sale that is no longer on this return; choose it again or remove the row.
Revision.Target: 某条外国来源记录所指定的境外经营企业或投资出售交易已不在本申报表中；请重新选择，或移除该条记录。

Revision.Source: Funding exceeds the annual amount for the coverage at transfer and the owner's age-55 catch-up; both permitted transfers share the family maximum.
Revision.Target: 转入资金超过了按转入时保险覆盖类型确定的年度限额与所有者年满 55 岁的追加供款额度之和；两次获准转入共用同一家庭最高限额。

Revision.Source: Guaranteed payments (Schedule K-1 (1065) boxes 4a and 4b) where the Form 4562 line 11 business income limit binds need an established treatment as active-business compensation, which this App does not calculate.
Revision.Target: 如果 4562 表第 11 行的营业收入限额构成限制，保证付款（附表 K-1（1065 表）第 4a 和 4b 栏）需明确按实际经营业务的报酬处理；本应用不计算这种处理。

Revision.Source: The selected health deduction and retained premium subsidy exceed a linked plan's available source expenses, or its subsidy allocation exceeds the actual enrollment source. No complete estimate can be reported from an overallocated source.
Revision.Target: 所选医疗保险扣除额与保留的保费补贴之和，超过了关联保险计划来源记录中的可用费用，或分摊给该计划的补贴超过了实际参保来源记录的金额。来源金额被过度分配时，无法提供完整估算。

Revision.Source: The initial health-insurance and premium-credit calculation must omit rental real estate losses before completing Form 8582. The source-supported interim treatment is not verified for competing non-rental passive losses, concurrent nonpassive rental losses, or disposed/former-passive loss releases. No complete estimate can be reported from a guessed allocation.
Revision.Target: 在完成 8582 表之前，首次计算医疗保险和保费税收抵免时必须排除出租房地产亏损。对于同时存在需分配扣除限额的非出租被动亏损、非被动出租亏损，或因处置活动或原被动活动而获准扣除的亏损，尚未验证有来源依据的临时处理方法。无法根据猜测的分摊提供完整估算。

Revision.Source: Health-service program-paid interest and interest your employer paid under an educational assistance program together cannot exceed the student loan interest entered. Reconcile the entries so no payment is subtracted twice.
Revision.Target: 医疗服务计划支付的利息与雇主通过教育援助计划支付的利息之和，不得超过已录入的学生贷款利息。请核对各项录入，确保没有任何付款被重复减去。

Revision.Source: An estate's or trust's final-year state and local taxes with an actual-expense home office are not calculated (Form 8829 Line 11 Worksheet lines 1-4).
Revision.Target: 对于按实际费用法申报居家办公费用的情况，本应用不计算遗产或信托最后一个纳税年度的州税和地方税（8829 表第 11 行工作表第 1–4 行）。

Revision.Source: A mortgage interest credit with an actual-expense home office is not calculated (Form 8396 and Form 8829 line 10).
Revision.Target: 对于按实际费用法申报居家办公费用的情况，本应用不计算住房贷款利息抵免（8396 表及 8829 表第 10 行）。

Revision.Source: Mortgage insurance premiums reduced by the adjusted gross income limit with an actual-expense home office need the Mortgage Insurance Premiums Deduction Worksheet for Form 8829 and are not calculated (Form 8829 lines 10 and 16).
Revision.Target: 对于按实际费用法申报居家办公费用的情况，因调整后总收入限额而调减的住房贷款保险费需要使用 8829 表的住房贷款保险费扣除工作表，本应用不予计算（8829 表第 10 和 16 行）。

Revision.Source: Home mortgage interest above the Pub 936 limit with an actual-expense home office is not calculated (Form 8829 lines 10 and 16).
Revision.Target: 对于按实际费用法申报居家办公费用的情况，本应用不计算超过第 936 号刊物限额的住房贷款利息（8829 表第 10 和 16 行）。

Revision.Source: When you itemize, enter the Form 1098 for the home with the office under Home mortgage interest as well; its interest or mortgage insurance premiums are less than the office's (Form 8829 line 10, Schedule A lines 8a and 8d).
Revision.Target: 如果您采用逐项扣除，也请在“住房贷款利息”下录入设有办公室的住宅所对应的 1098 表；此处的利息或住房贷款保险费少于居家办公记录中的金额（8829 表第 10 行、附表 A 第 8a 和 8d 行）。

Revision.Source: When you itemize, include the real estate taxes of the home with the office under Taxes you paid as well; they are less than the office's real estate taxes (Form 8829 Line 11 Worksheet, Schedule A line 5b).
Revision.Target: 如果您采用逐项扣除，也请在“已缴税款”下计入设有办公室的住宅的房地产税；此处的金额少于居家办公记录中的房地产税（8829 表第 11 行工作表、附表 A 第 5b 行）。

Revision.Source: An exchange of a home is calculated for a whole property held more than a year and paid in full; a separate business or rental space, an installment note or a short holding period is not calculated with it (Form 8824).
Revision.Target: 本应用可计算持有超过一年且已全额结清价款的整处住宅交换；若同时涉及独立的营业或出租空间、分期付款票据或较短的持有期，则不予计算（8824 表）。

Revision.Source: The tax the buyer withheld from a foreign seller (Form 8288-A) is not known, so the credit on Form 1040 line 25c cannot be figured.
Revision.Target: 买方向外国卖方预扣的税款（8288-A 表）尚不明确，因此无法计算 1040 表第 25c 行的抵免额。

Revision.Source: An installment sale needs a contract price above zero: the loans the buyer took over must be less than the sale price (Form 6252 line 18).
Revision.Target: 分期付款出售的合同价款必须大于零：买方承接的贷款必须少于售价（6252 表第 18 行）。

Revision.Source: An installment sale that also sells a separate business or rental space is not calculated (a separate Form 6252 for each part).
Revision.Target: 本应用不计算同时出售独立营业或出租空间的分期付款出售交易（每个部分须分别填写一份 6252 表）。

Revision.Source: Whether the earlier owner got this home in a like-kind exchange within 5 years of the sale is not known, so the exclusion cannot be told (section 121(d)(10), Pub. 523).
Revision.Target: 尚不明确先前所有者是否在出售前的 5 年内通过同类财产交换取得该住宅，因此无法确定是否适用免税待遇（第 121(d)(10) 条、第 523 号刊物）。

Revision.Source: The value of the property or services received as part of the price (1099-S box 6) is not known, so the amount realized cannot be figured (Pub. 523).
Revision.Target: 作为价款一部分收到的财产或服务的价值（1099-S 表第 6 栏）尚不明确，因此无法计算处置所得金额（第 523 号刊物）。

Revision.Source: Provide both spouses' home histories for a joint return and only the taxpayer's otherwise.
Revision.Target: 联合申报时，请提供夫妻双方的住宅历史记录；其他情况下，只需提供纳税人本人的记录。

Revision.Source: Provide separate reduced-exclusion periods for each joint filer, and no spouse periods on other returns.
Revision.Target: 请分别填写联合申报双方用于计算部分免税额的期间；其他申报表不得填写配偶的期间。

Revision.Source: Depreciation on a home held one year or less is not calculated (Form 4797).
Revision.Target: 不计算持有一年或以下的住宅的折旧（表格4797）。

Revision.Source: The surviving-spouse exclusion needs your own two-year ownership and residence, no excluded sale in the two years before and a sale held more than a year; otherwise evaluate a reduced exclusion.
Revision.Target: 适用丧偶配偶免税额要求您本人拥有并居住满两年、出售前两年内未享受过售房收益免税，且所售住宅的持有期超过一年；否则，请评估是否适用部分免税额。

Revision.Source: The depreciation on the separate business or rental space is not known, so its gain and the share of the price left for your home cannot be figured (Form 4797; Pub. 523). Your Schedule C, Schedule E and Form 4562 records show it.
Revision.Target: 独立经营或出租空间的折旧未知，因此无法计算其收益以及售价中归属于住宅的剩余部分（表格4797；第523号出版物）。可在您的附表C、附表E和表格4562记录中查找该折旧。

Revision.Source: Passive rental losses carried over from earlier years are released by the sale of the rental space (Form 8582, section 469(g)), which is not calculated here.
Revision.Target: 出售出租空间后，以前年度结转的被动出租亏损可获准扣除（表格8582，第469(g)条）；此处不计算这项扣除。

Revision.Source: A separate business or rental space sold within a year of acquisition is ordinary income on Form 4797 Part II, which is not calculated.
Revision.Target: 独立经营或出租空间在取得后一年内出售的，须在表格4797第II部分按普通收入处理；此处不计算。

Revision.Source: Sale of your main home: the tax on a person who gave up citizenship or long-term residence (Form 8854, section 877A) is a return-wide tax on a dual-status return, which is not calculated.
Revision.Target: 出售主要住宅：放弃公民身份或长期居民身份者的税款（表格8854，第877A条）须在双重身份申报表上按整份申报表计算；此处不计算。

Revision.Source: The full ownership/residence exclusion is not established; evaluate reduced or special exclusions before completing this sale.
Revision.Target: 尚未确认满足拥有及居住条件以享受全额免税额；完成此项售房申报前，请评估是否适用部分或特殊免税额。

Revision.Source: The selected event does not establish a reduced home-sale exclusion; review other facts and circumstances.
Revision.Target: 所选事件不足以确认符合售房收益部分免税的条件；请核查其他事实和情况。

Revision.Source: Housing requires a valid qualifying period overlapping 2026.
Revision.Target: 住房优惠要求有一段有效的符合资格期间，且该期间须与2026年重叠。

Revision.Source: Housing stays must have nonoverlapping inclusive dates within the 2026 qualifying period.
Revision.Target: 各段住房居住期间须位于2026年符合资格的期间内，且按包含起止日在内计算时不得重叠。

Revision.Source: Income document {0,number,0}
Revision.Target: 收入凭证{0,number,0}

Revision.Source: Income-limited section 179 with adoption or care benefits needs the coordinated employee-compensation worksheet.
Revision.Target: 受收入限制的第179条扣除若涉及收养或照护福利，须使用统筹计算的雇员报酬工作表。

Revision.Source: Income-tax expense attribution could change the Form 4952 deduction or carryforward and needs additional coordination.
Revision.Target: 所得税费用的归属可能改变表格4952的扣除额或结转额，需要进一步统筹处理。

Revision.Source: The group's qualified disaster distributions cannot include amounts already excluded for a qualified charitable distribution or qualified HSA funding. Reconcile the actual linked payments.
Revision.Target: 该组的合格灾害分配款不得包含已按合格慈善分配款或合格HSA注资免税的金额。请核对实际关联的各笔款项。

Revision.Source: Inherited gifts must follow the original owner's death and be included in the linked group's gross beneficiary distributions.
Revision.Target: 继承账户的赠与必须发生在原所有人去世后，并计入关联组的受益人分配款总额。

Revision.Source: This payment names an Inherited IRA of the other kind: a Roth IRA payment needs the Roth record and a traditional IRA payment the traditional one.
Revision.Target: 这笔款项指定的继承IRA类型不符：Roth IRA款项须关联Roth记录，传统IRA款项须关联传统IRA记录。

Revision.Source: This payment names an Inherited IRA that belongs to the other filer. Choose one of this filer's own.
Revision.Target: 这笔款项指定的继承IRA属于另一位申报人。请选择属于本申报人的账户。

Revision.Source: An individual medical account beneficiary must survive the original holder; use estate treatment when the estate is the beneficiary.
Revision.Target: 医疗账户的个人受益人必须晚于原持有人去世；若受益人为遗产，请按遗产受益人的规则处理。

Revision.Source: An estate-beneficiary account belongs on the original holder's final return; its death date must match People.
Revision.Target: 以遗产为受益人的账户应列入原持有人的最终申报表；其死亡日期必须与“人员”中的记录一致。

Revision.Source: Dealer sales of property held for customers cannot use this capital installment-sale worksheet.
Revision.Target: 经销商出售为向客户销售而持有的财产时，不得使用这份资本资产分期销售工作表。

Revision.Source: Installment gain from an earlier sale of rental or passive-activity property is passive income that allows part of this return's unallowed passive losses (Form 8582 lines 1 through 4), which is not calculated.
Revision.Target: 以前出售出租财产或被动活动财产产生的分期销售收益属于被动收入，可使本申报表中部分原不准扣除的被动活动亏损获准扣除（表格8582第1至4行）；此处不计算。

Revision.Source: Installment notes from 2026 sales above $150,000 total more than $5,000,000 at the end of 2026, so interest is owed on the deferred tax (section 453A, Form 6252 and Publication 537), which is not calculated.
Revision.Target: 2026年售价超过150,000美元的销售所产生的分期付款票据，在2026年底的合计金额超过5,000,000美元，因此须就递延税款支付利息（第453A条、表格6252及第537号出版物）；此处不计算该利息。

Revision.Source: A contingent installment price without a stated maximum requires a separate basis recovery schedule; this sale is not calculated.
Revision.Target: 未约定最高售价的或有价款分期销售须另行编制计税基础回收明细表；此处不计算这项销售。

Revision.Source: Installment sale: the loans the buyer took over and the principal received in 2026 cannot exceed the sale price (Form 6252 lines 5, 6 and 21).
Revision.Target: 分期销售：买方承接的贷款与2026年收到的本金合计不得超过售价（表格6252第5、6及21行）。

Revision.Source: Installment sales of qualified small business stock require the exclusion history; this sale is not calculated.
Revision.Target: 分期出售合格小型企业股票需要以往的免税记录；此处不计算这项销售。

Revision.Source: An installment sale to a related party, by a dealer, with a price that depends on later events, or with a note pledged as security or disposed of in 2026 is not calculated (Form 6252 lines 3 and 4 and Part III; sections 453(e), 453(g), 453A(d) and 453B).
Revision.Target: 不计算以下分期销售：向关联方销售、经销商销售、售价取决于后续事件的销售，或相关票据在2026年被用作担保或被处置的销售（表格6252第3、4行及第III部分；第453(e)、453(g)、453A(d)及453B条）。

Revision.Source: An installment note charging less than the applicable federal rate has unstated interest: part of the sale price is interest income (Form 6252 line 5; sections 483 and 1274, Publication 537), which is not calculated.
Revision.Target: 利率低于适用联邦利率的分期付款票据存在未列明利息：部分售价须计为利息收入（表格6252第5行；第483及1274条、第537号出版物）；此处不计算。

Revision.Target: 本部分有重复的记录标识。

Revision.Target: 有一条记录已不再属于本部分。请重新打开本部分。

Revision.Source: Review the accepted page values before saving.
Revision.Target: 保存前，请核查页面上已确认的值。

Revision.Source: The record identity limit has been reached.
Revision.Target: 已达到记录标识数量上限。

Revision.Source: This return has reached the supported revision limit.
Revision.Target: 本申报表已达到支持的修订次数上限。

Revision.Source: Investment credit property sold or taken out of use within five years needs a confirmed credit history; recapture from increased nonrecourse financing or a later prevailing-wage failure (Form 4255 Parts II Section C and IV) is not calculated.
Revision.Target: 享受投资税收抵免的财产若在五年内出售或停止使用，须有经确认的抵免历史记录；因无追索权融资增加或后来未满足现行工资要求而产生的抵免追回税额（表格4255第II部分C节及第IV部分），此处不计算。

Revision.Source: Confirm every actual 2027 IRA deposit was made by April 15 and designated for 2026 with its custodian. Its traditional and Roth amounts must be included once in the matching retained 2026 contribution totals.
Revision.Target: 请确认2027年实际存入IRA的每笔款项均在4月15日或之前存入，且已向托管机构指定为2026年度供款。相应的传统IRA和Roth IRA金额必须分别计入已保留的2026年度供款总额，且仅计入一次。

Revision.Source: The voluntary nondeductible amount must be between zero and this filer's regular traditional contributions.
Revision.Target: 自愿选择不予扣除的金额必须介于零与本申报人的常规传统IRA供款额之间。

Revision.Source: Confirm each 2026 direct 529-to-Roth transfer, its distinct source-account history and five-year seasoned amount after earlier transfers, its source contribution/earnings split, and the $35,000 beneficiary lifetime room across all accounts.
Revision.Target: 请确认2026年每笔从529账户直接转入Roth IRA的款项、各自来源账户的历史记录、扣除先前转账后已存满五年的金额、转出金额中供款与收益的划分，以及受益人在所有账户合计35,000美元终身限额下的剩余额度。

Revision.Source: Form 5329 Part IV line 23: 2026 Roth IRA contributions exceed this filer's income-based, age-based or compensation limit. Enter the December 31, 2026 IRA values under More about these contributions on the IRA contributions page so the 6% tax is calculated, or correct or recharacterize the excess.
Revision.Target: 表格5329第IV部分第23行：2026年Roth IRA供款超过了本申报人按收入、年龄或报酬确定的限额。请在“IRA供款”页面的“关于这些供款的更多信息”下填写2026年12月31日的IRA账户价值，以便计算6%的税款；也可纠正超额供款或重新界定其类型。

Revision.Source: Complete both IRA coverage records for a joint return; remove spouse IRA facts for any other filing status.
Revision.Target: 联合申报须填写双方的IRA退休计划覆盖情况记录；其他申报身份须删除配偶的IRA信息。

Revision.Source: Choose the IRA spouse situation matching filing status and whether you lived together during the year.
Revision.Target: 请选择与申报身份及年内是否共同居住相符的IRA配偶情况。

Revision.Source: Form 5329 Part III line 15: 2026 traditional IRA contributions exceed this filer's age-based or compensation limit. Enter the December 31, 2026 IRA values under More about these contributions on the IRA contributions page so the 6% tax is calculated, or correct the excess.
Revision.Target: 表格5329第III部分第15行：2026年传统IRA供款超过了本申报人按年龄或报酬确定的限额。请在“IRA供款”页面的“关于这些供款的更多信息”下填写2026年12月31日的IRA账户价值，以便计算6%的税款；也可纠正超额供款。

Revision.Source: This estimate does not yet calculate the combined basis, at-risk and passive limits for these activity records.
Revision.Target: 本估算尚不能综合计算这些活动记录的计税基础限额、风险承担限额及被动活动限额。

Revision.Source: Your AMT basis allows a different section 179 deduction, contribution, other-income loss or other deduction than your regular basis, and this App does not calculate those differing allowances.
Revision.Target: 按替代性最低税（AMT）计税基础可准许的第179条扣除、捐赠扣除、其他收入项下亏损或其他扣除，与常规计税基础下的金额不同，本应用不计算这些不同的准许金额。

Revision.Source: The K-1's supporting statement is needed to identify the AMT activity adjustment's form line.
Revision.Target: 需要K-1的补充说明，才能确定AMT活动调整应填入表格的哪一行。

Revision.Source: A section 199A statement with items from a specified agricultural or horticultural cooperative (Form 8995-A Schedule D patron reduction and the section 199A(g) deduction) is not calculated.
Revision.Target: 不计算包含特定农业或园艺合作社项目的第199A条说明表（表格8995-A附表D的社员扣减额及第199A(g)条扣除）。

Revision.Source: Carbon oxide sequestration credit recapture (K-1 code AX, Form 8933 Part III) is not calculated.
Revision.Target: 不计算碳氧化物封存抵免的追回税额（K-1代码AX，表格8933第III部分）。

Revision.Source: A part sale, gift, transfer at death, sale to a related person, installment sale, liquidation with property, redemption, carried interest (section 1061) or interest held partly one year or less is not calculated.
Revision.Target: 不计算部分出售、赠与、死亡时转让、向关联人出售、分期销售、以财产进行清算、赎回、附带权益（第1061条），或部分权益持有期为一年或以下的情形。

Revision.Source: A gain on a partnership interest or S corporation shares — a distribution above your basis or a sale — from a business you materially participate in, with modified AGI above the net investment income tax threshold, needs the Form 8960 line 5c adjustment for the entity's business property (proposed Regulations section 1.1411-7), which this App does not calculate.
Revision.Target: 如果您实质参与某项业务，且修正后调整总收入超过净投资所得税起征门槛，那么该业务的合伙权益或S型公司股份产生的收益——超过计税基础的分配款或出售收益——需要针对该实体的经营财产进行表格8960第5c行调整（拟议法规第1.1411-7条）；本应用不计算该调整。

Revision.Source: {0}: investment interest (box 13 code H or box 12 code H) with a loss the at-risk limit holds back needs Form 4952 and Form 6198 together, which this App does not calculate.
Revision.Target: {0}：投资利息（第13栏代码H或第12栏代码H）若涉及因风险承担限额而暂不准扣除的亏损，须结合表格4952和表格6198计算；本应用不进行此项计算。

Revision.Source: Business-property gains, losses and their carryovers in a publicly traded partnership need its separate property and passive-loss worksheets; they are not calculated.
Revision.Target: 公开交易合伙企业的经营财产收益、亏损及其结转额须使用该企业单独的财产及被动活动亏损工作表；此处不计算。

Revision.Source: A Schedule K-1 box 2 rental real estate activity in which a real estate professional materially participated needs that owner's Real estate professional answer on About you or About your spouse.
Revision.Target: 如果房地产专业人士实质参与了附表K-1第2栏的房地产出租活动，须在“关于您”或“关于您的配偶”中填写该所有人的“房地产专业人士”答案。

Revision.Source: A rental activity's section 1231 loss held back by basis or at-risk limits needs an activity-specific property carryover that this K-1 record does not calculate.
Revision.Target: 出租活动的第1231条亏损若因计税基础限额或风险承担限额而暂不准扣除，须按该活动单独计算财产亏损结转额；本K-1记录不计算该结转额。

Revision.Source: A disposition involving rental activities of a publicly traded partnership needs its separate entire-interest and suspended-loss worksheet.
Revision.Target: 涉及公开交易合伙企业出租活动的处置，须使用该企业单独的全部权益及暂缓扣除亏损工作表。

Revision.Source: A real estate professional rental of a publicly traded partnership needs its separate former-passive and participation worksheet.
Revision.Target: 房地产专业人士涉及公开交易合伙企业的出租活动时，须使用该企业单独的原被动活动及参与情况工作表。

Revision.Source: Rental property gains, losses and property passive-loss carryovers of a publicly traded partnership need its separate property-character worksheet.
Revision.Target: 公开交易合伙企业的出租财产收益、亏损及财产被动活动亏损结转额，须使用该企业单独的财产性质工作表。

Revision.Source: A rental section 199A statement of a publicly traded partnership needs its actual qualified-source and specified-service classification before the qualified PTP deduction can be calculated.
Revision.Target: 公开交易合伙企业的出租活动第199A条说明表须明确其实际的合格来源及特定服务业务分类，才能计算合格公开交易合伙企业（PTP）扣除。

Revision.Source: The rental activities of this publicly traded partnership need the same selected regular or AMT passive-loss source, including its checked section 179 allocation.
Revision.Target: 这家公开交易合伙企业的各项出租活动须选用相同的常规税或AMT被动活动亏损来源，包括其中已勾选的第179条分配额。

Revision.Source: AMT amounts for a section 179 sale are unavailable. Enter the property's AMT statement before its AMT sale worksheet can be calculated.
Revision.Target: 缺少第179条财产出售的替代性最低税（AMT）金额。请先录入该财产的AMT明细，才能计算其AMT出售工作表。

Revision.Source: More than one section 179 property was sold and a carryover belongs to sold property. Each property's carryover must be allocated separately; this K-1 does not calculate that allocation.
Revision.Target: 出售的第179条财产不止一项，且有结转额属于已出售的财产。必须分别分配每项财产的结转额；此K-1不计算这项分配。

Revision.Source: Review this K-1's sale losses and owner loss worksheets; the allowed amounts do not reconcile.
Revision.Target: 请核查此K-1的出售亏损和所有人亏损工作表；允许扣除的金额不一致。

Revision.Source: Enter valid section 179 sale statements and nonnegative carryover amounts within the supported limits.
Revision.Target: 请录入有效的第179条财产出售明细，以及支持范围内的非负结转额。

Revision.Source: The section 199A statement and loss records do not determine the qualified share of the section 1231 lookback recapture. Provide a business-level qualified allocation.
Revision.Target: 第199A条明细和亏损记录无法确定第1231条回溯追缴额中的合格部分。请按业务提供合格部分的分配。

Revision.Source: K-1 box 13 code R for an IRA payment or a SEP with other facts (Schedule 1 line 16 or 20; Form 7206 line 9) is not calculated.
Revision.Target: 不计算K-1第13栏代码R中用于IRA缴款或涉及其他情况的SEP的金额（附表1第16或20行；表格7206第9行）。

Revision.Source: Life expectancy is exhausted: supply the actual December 31, 2026 remaining account value, including earnings. Last year's balance is not the full-distribution shortfall.
Revision.Target: 预期寿命年限已用尽：请提供2026年12月31日账户实际剩余价值，包括收益。上年余额并不等于全额提取要求下的不足额。

Revision.Source: Link a same-owner 2026 traditional IRA birth/adoption, emergency, domestic-abuse or terminal-illness distribution. Repay after distribution and within three years, no more than its qualified gross amount.
Revision.Target: 请关联同一所有人2026年因生育或收养、紧急支出、家庭暴力或绝症而从传统IRA提取的款项。偿还必须在提取之后的三年内进行，且不得超过该笔款项的合格总额。

Revision.Source: Link a same-owner IRA distribution and matching traditional or Roth basis method. Roth source distributions cannot follow HSA receipt and need complete opening history. Basis funding needs dated aggregate balances. Earlier own nonqualified Roth withdrawals require confirmed opening history and distinct actual payment dates. Current regular contributions are supported only when each recorded Roth value covers its transfer plus all opening basis and retained annual regular contributions; other incoming basis or earlier activity needs further support. Inherited sources need the linked beneficiary/deceased-owner history and must follow the original owner's death. Nonqualified inherited Roth funding also supports dated ordinary withdrawals in that group; its opening regular and conversion basis remains separate from personal accounts and other deceased owners. A funding-first answer cannot override an entered earlier ordinary withdrawal date in that same Roth group.
Revision.Target: 请关联同一所有人的IRA提取记录，并选择匹配的传统IRA或Roth IRA计税基础处理方法。作为资金来源的Roth提取不得晚于HSA收款，且需要完整的期初历史记录。使用计税基础提供资金时，需要带日期的账户合计余额。本人此前从Roth账户进行的非合格常规提取，需要经确认的期初历史记录和各笔不同的实际支付日期。只有每笔记录的Roth账户价值足以涵盖该笔转移额、全部期初计税基础以及保留的年度常规缴款时，才支持本年度常规缴款；其他转入的计税基础或更早的交易需要进一步资料支持。继承账户作为资金来源时，需要关联受益人及已故所有人的历史记录，且提取必须发生在原所有人去世之后。非合格继承Roth账户提供资金时，也支持同组内带日期的常规提取；其期初常规缴款及转换计税基础仍与个人账户及其他已故所有人的账户分开处理。选择先提供资金，不能覆盖同一Roth组中已录入的更早常规提取日期。

Revision.Source: Link each inherited gift to an existing inherited traditional IRA income entry belonging to this filer.
Revision.Target: 请将每笔来自继承账户的捐赠关联到属于此申报人的现有继承传统IRA收入记录。

Revision.Source: Link each premium to the officer's governmental pension or disability-pension Income entry with a supported taxable-amount calculation. An IRA, commercial annuity or railroad pension does not qualify.
Revision.Target: 请将每笔保费关联到该公共安全人员的政府养老金或伤残养老金收入记录，且该记录的应税金额计算方式必须受支持。IRA、商业年金或铁路养老金不符合条件。

Revision.Source: Link the employer or business maintaining the HDHP to calculate the compensation limit.
Revision.Target: 请关联提供高免赔额健康保险计划（HDHP）的雇主或企业，以计算报酬限额。

Revision.Source: Losses exceeding the ordinary allowance with both short- and long-term lots need a verified allocation of the annual allowance.
Revision.Target: 亏损超过普通扣除限额且同时涉及短期和长期持有批次时，需要经核实的年度扣除限额分配。

Revision.Source: Loss-origin worksheet balances must reconcile separately to the calculated short- and long-term carryovers after 2025 use. Supply all surviving years or leave the optional history empty when unavailable.
Revision.Target: 亏损来源工作表的余额必须分别与扣除2025年已使用金额后计算出的短期及长期结转额一致。请提供所有仍有结余年份的记录；如无法取得，可将此可选历史记录留空。

Revision.Source: The actual life-policy or viatical facts do not establish section 101(g) treatment. Its required income needs the existing life or annuity source calculation; the receipt cannot be treated as zero income.
Revision.Target: 实际寿险保单或重病患者保单转让的情况不足以确定是否适用第101(g)条税务处理。其必须计入的收入需要使用现有寿险或年金来源的计算；不能将该笔收款按零收入处理。

Revision.Source: This nonqualified long-term-care receipt needs its actual accident/health, life or annuity tax treatment. Its mandatory taxable income is not established by Form 1099-LTC alone.
Revision.Target: 这笔非合格长期护理收款需要按其实际性质，采用意外伤害或健康保险、寿险或年金的税务处理。仅凭表格1099-LTC无法确定其必须计入的应税收入。

Revision.Source: This 1099-LTC names a Long-term care periods record that belongs to the other filer. Choose one of this filer's own.
Revision.Target: 此1099-LTC指定的长期护理期间记录属于另一位申报人。请选择属于此申报人的记录。

Revision.Source: The payments of the periods do not total the per diem payments on the 1099-LTCs that name this record. Make each period's payments add up to them.
Revision.Target: 各期间的给付合计与指定此记录的各份1099-LTC上的按日给付总额不一致。请调整各期间的给付，使其合计与该总额一致。

Revision.Source: Establish the actual source of the LTC insurance receipt before estimating its required taxable income.
Revision.Target: 请先确定长期护理保险收款的实际来源，再估算其必须计入的应税收入。

Revision.Source: A lump sum shared with other recipients (box 9a) or with an annuity share (box 8b) is figured from its own statement. It cannot be combined with another 1099-R of the same participant's lump sum.
Revision.Target: 与其他领取人共享的一次性给付（第9a栏），或包含年金份额的一次性给付（第8b栏），须按其各自明细计算。不能将其与同一参与人同笔一次性给付的另一份1099-R合并。

Revision.Source: All of a participant's lump-sum distributions in one year must be taxed the same way. Choose the same Form 4972 method for each 1099-R of this participant, or tax none of them separately.
Revision.Target: 同一参与人在一年内的所有一次性给付必须采用相同的计税方式。请为该参与人的每份1099-R选择相同的表格4972方法，或全部不采用单独计税。

Revision.Source: Marketplace coverage established under more than one business needs the credit allocated among them (Pub. 974 Step 3, More than one trade or business).
Revision.Target: 通过多个业务设立的医保市场保险，需要在这些业务之间分配税收抵免（第974号刊物步骤3“多个行业或业务”）。

Revision.Source: The alternative calculation for the year of marriage (Form 8962 Part V, lines 35 and 36, Pub. 974 Worksheets I and V) is not calculated.
Revision.Target: 不计算结婚当年的替代计算方法（表格8962第V部分第35和36行，第974号刊物工作表I和V）。

Revision.Source: Coverage of a person not lawfully present in the United States (Form 8962 lines 1 to 5 and column (f), Pub. 974 Worksheets A and B) is not calculated.
Revision.Target: 不计算不具备美国合法居留身份者的保险相关金额（表格8962第1至5行及第(f)列，第974号刊物工作表A和B）。

Revision.Source: A QSEHRA permitted benefit (Form 8962 lines 11 to 23 column (e), Pub. 974 Worksheets N and Q) is not calculated.
Revision.Target: 不计算合格小型雇主健康报销安排（QSEHRA）的允许福利金额（表格8962第11至23行第(e)列，第974号刊物工作表N和Q）。

Revision.Source: A policy shared among three or more tax families (Form 8962 Part IV lines 30 to 33, Pub. 974 Allocation of Policy Amounts Among Three or More Taxpayers) is not calculated.
Revision.Target: 不计算三个或更多纳税家庭共用保单的相关金额（表格8962第IV部分第30至33行，第974号刊物“三名或更多纳税人之间的保单金额分配”）。

Revision.Source: Enrollment premiums not paid by April 15, 2027 are left out of Form 8962 lines 11 to 23 column (a) and change the months that can take the credit; this is not calculated.
Revision.Target: 截至2027年4月15日尚未支付的参保保费须从表格8962第11至23行第(a)列中排除，并会改变可申领税收抵免的月份；此情况不予计算。

Revision.Source: A Schedule K-1 section 179 amount on a married-separate return needs the spouse's eligible purchases and agreed dollar-limit allocation; without them the amount is lost while still reducing basis, which is not calculated.
Revision.Target: 已婚分别申报时，附表K-1中的第179条金额需要配偶的合格购置金额及双方约定的金额限额分配；缺少这些信息时，该金额会丧失扣除资格，但仍会减少计税基础，此情况不予计算。

Revision.Source: Match each original filing unit to these filers. A prior joint return with a different or absent spouse requires ownership allocation.
Revision.Target: 请将每个原申报单位与当前申报人匹配。此前的联合申报如涉及不同配偶或当前申报中未列出的配偶，需要按归属分配。

Revision.Source: Match repayments to the original recipient and benefit component. Contributory repayments with tax-free basis recovery require a separate allocation; unrelated pension or unemployment income cannot supply the repaid amount.
Revision.Target: 请将偿还款与原领取人及福利组成部分匹配。缴费型福利的偿还款如涉及免税收回计税基础，需要单独分配；不能用无关的养老金或失业救济收入充作所偿还的金额。

Revision.Source: Two Medicare Advantage MSA forms for the same person show different December 31, 2025 balances. Use the same account value on each.
Revision.Target: 同一人的两份Medicare Advantage MSA表格显示的2025年12月31日余额不同。请在每份表格中使用相同的账户价值。

Revision.Source: Medicare withholding below ordinary payroll tax requires special payroll review.
Revision.Target: Medicare预扣税低于常规工资税额，需要专项核查工资税。

Revision.Source: Mixed qualified/nonqualified losses combined with profitable activities, or special entity/property character, need further suspended-loss allocation. Loss-only ordinary sources preserve their qualified proportions.
Revision.Target: 合格与非合格亏损混合且涉及盈利活动，或实体或财产具有特殊税务性质时，需要进一步分配暂缓扣除的亏损。只有亏损的普通来源会保留其合格部分比例。

Revision.Source: Modified adjusted gross income above $505,000 ($252,500 if married filing separately) with an actual-expense home office needs the Line 11 Worksheet iteration (Form 8829 line 11) and is not calculated.
Revision.Target: 修正后调整总收入超过$505,000（已婚分别申报为$252,500），且家庭办公室采用实际费用法时，需要对第11行工作表进行迭代计算（表格8829第11行）；此情况不予计算。

Revision.Source: Excess-loss allocation across multiple businesses remains incomplete.
Revision.Target: 多个业务之间的超额亏损分配尚未完成。

Revision.Source: Multiple excluded home sales in one year require coordinated spouse and prior-sale allocation.
Revision.Target: 同一年内多次出售住房并适用收益免税时，需要统筹配偶及此前售房的分配。

Revision.Source: Multiple self-employed plans need combined plan-limit and related-employer worksheets.
Revision.Target: 有多个自雇退休计划时，需要合并计划限额工作表及关联雇主工作表。

Revision.Source: The nonresident spouse has income documents other than wages, interest and dividends. Without the joint election for the net investment income tax, the U.S. spouse's separate figures cannot be separated from them here; choose the joint election or review Form 8960.
Revision.Target: 非居民配偶有工资、利息和股息以外的收入凭证。如未选择共同适用净投资所得税，此处无法从中分离出美国配偶的单独金额；请选择共同适用，或核查表格8960。

Revision.Source: Nondeductible contributions and IRA distributions for the same owner require a complete basis worksheet in Adjustments.
Revision.Target: 同一所有人既有不可扣除的缴款又有IRA提取时，需要在“调整项”中填写完整的计税基础工作表。

Revision.Source: Notary gross income cannot exceed this business’s gross income after cost of goods.
Revision.Target: 公证业务总收入不得超过此业务扣除销售成本后的总收入。

Revision.Source: Notary profit cannot exceed this business's net profit.
Revision.Target: 公证业务利润不得超过此业务的净利润。

Revision.Source: Obtain the applicable second-lowest-cost silver plan premium from the Marketplace or HealthCare.gov's tax tool before claiming credit for a paid coverage month (Form 8962 lines 11 to 23 column (b)).
Revision.Target: 为已支付保费的承保月份申领税收抵免前，请先从医保市场或HealthCare.gov的税务工具获取适用的第二低价银级计划保费（表格8962第11至23行第(b)列）。

Revision.Source: Only one annual emergency distribution per person is permitted; enter traditional IRA repayments in the owner's basis record.
Revision.Target: 每人每年只允许一次紧急支出提取；请在所有人的计税基础记录中录入传统IRA偿还款。

Revision.Source: Only one home office figured with actual expenses is calculated on a return, and not with a simplified-method office of the same owner (a second Form 8829 or the line 36 allocation between businesses).
Revision.Target: 每份申报表仅计算一处采用实际费用法的家庭办公室，且不能同时计算同一所有人采用简化法的办公室（不计算第二份表格8829或第36行的业务间分配）。

Revision.Source: Only one previously owned vehicle credit per buyer may be selected within this three-year window.
Revision.Target: 在此三年期限内，每位买家只能选择一次二手车税收抵免。

Revision.Source: Ordinary Roth withdrawals before the last qualified funding transfer require supported own-account nonqualified, dated ordering. Current regular contributions need enough recorded earnings to cover every funding transfer without using basis; other earlier activity needs further support. Funding-only earlier entries are permitted.
Revision.Target: 在最后一笔合格资金转移之前进行的Roth常规提取，需要采用受支持的本人账户非合格提取处理方式，并按日期确定顺序。本年度常规缴款需要有足够的已记录收益，以便每笔资金转移均不动用计税基础；其他更早的交易需要进一步资料支持。允许录入更早且仅用于提供资金的记录。

Revision.Source: Original exclusion-only incoming losses must reconcile with the preceding worksheet.
Revision.Target: 原先仅用于收入排除计算的转入亏损必须与前一份工作表一致。

Revision.Source: Original railroad income must belong to a filer on this historical return.
Revision.Target: 原铁路收入必须属于此历史申报表中的一位申报人。

Revision.Source: Original Social Security source records do not reproduce Form 1040 line 6b. Reconcile benefits, exempt interest, filing status and original-year adjustments.
Revision.Target: 根据原社会保障收入来源记录计算的结果与表格1040第6b行不一致。请核对福利金额、免税利息、申报身份及原年度调整项。

Revision.Source: Original-year earned-income-credit facts and published table do not reproduce filed Form 1040 line 27. Reconcile the source return and any IRS changes.
Revision.Target: 根据原年度劳动所得税收抵免的相关资料及公布的税表计算的结果，与已提交的表格1040第27行不一致。请核对原申报表及IRS所作的任何变更。

Revision.Source: Original-year filing tables are not implemented for this year.
Revision.Target: 尚不支持该原始年度的报税税额表。

Revision.Source: Other taxes cannot exceed the retained Form 1040 line 16 amount.
Revision.Target: 其他税款不能超过已保留的 Form 1040 第 16 行金额。

Revision.Source: Nothing is entered from this paper: enter it from the printed form, or delete it.
Revision.Target: 尚未录入这份纸质表格中的任何内容：请根据打印的表格录入，或将其删除。

Revision.Source: A new activity cannot contain prior investment or loss history.
Revision.Target: 新活动不能包含以往的投资或亏损记录。

Revision.Source: A partnership self-employment source was supplied more than once.
Revision.Target: 同一合伙企业的自雇收入来源被重复提供。

Revision.Source: Complete the ordinary partner-basis source records and identify additional adjustments.
Revision.Target: 请补全普通损益的合伙人计税基础原始记录，并注明额外调整。

Revision.Source: Partnership earnings and income-dependent deductions did not stabilize to one consistent calculation. No final tax can be reported from these intermediate amounts.
Revision.Target: 合伙企业收益和取决于收入的扣除额未能得出稳定一致的计算结果。无法根据这些中间金额申报最终税额。

Revision.Source: Establish K-1 box 14 code A.
Revision.Target: 请确定 K-1 第 14 栏代码 A 的金额。

Revision.Source: Establish the partnership business classification and material participation before applying passive limits.
Revision.Target: 请先确定合伙企业的业务分类及实质性参与情况，再应用被动活动限制。

Revision.Source: Partner at-risk recapture requires separate return and character coordination.
Revision.Target: 合伙人因风险承担额减少而需转回的先前亏损扣除，须另行在纳税申报表层面统筹处理，并协调其税务性质。

Revision.Source: The App calculates ordinary PTP qualified losses from reconciled basis, at-risk and same-PTP passive records. Combinations with partner deductions or other carried characters, EBL combinations with positive business adjustments, and retained-loss combinations with property or full-interest sales still need a separate qualified-source worksheet.
Revision.Target: 本应用根据已核对一致的计税基础、风险承担额和同一公开交易合伙企业（PTP）的被动活动记录，计算 PTP 的普通合格亏损。涉及合伙人扣除或其他结转税务性质的组合、超额经营亏损（EBL）与正向经营调整的组合，以及保留亏损与财产出售或全部权益出售的组合，仍需另行使用合格来源计算表。

Revision.Source: Complete and reconcile the partnership's ordinary section 199A statement and partner adjustments.
Revision.Target: 请补全并核对合伙企业关于普通损益的第 199A 条明细及合伙人调整，确保一致。

Revision.Source: Complete historical partnership QBI loss records for each nonzero suspended balance.
Revision.Target: 请为每项非零暂缓扣除余额补全合伙企业以往的合格营业收入（QBI）亏损记录。

Revision.Source: Establish positive gross-income allocation weights for the owner's half-SE deduction.
Revision.Target: 请为业主的一半自雇税扣除确定大于零的总收入分配权重。

Revision.Source: Foreign profit offsets with mixed qualified/nonqualified losses require further allocation; uniformly qualified or nonqualified loss sources retain their character.
Revision.Target: 境外利润抵减同时包含合格与非合格部分的亏损时，需要进一步分配；全部为合格或全部为非合格的亏损来源保留其原有税务性质。

Revision.Source: Mixed partnership/Schedule C excess losses require ordinary loss-only sources with resolved domestic QBI or wholly foreign nonqualified character, without separate foreign exclusions, housing, health or retirement deductions.
Revision.Target: 合伙企业与 Schedule C 混合的超额亏损，要求各来源仅有普通亏损，且已确定其性质为境内 QBI 或全部属于境外非合格项目，同时不涉及单独的境外收入免税、住房、医疗保险或退休计划扣除。

Revision.Source: Mixed partnership/S-corporation property character needs separate allocation.
Revision.Target: 合伙企业与 S 型公司混合涉及的财产税务性质，需要另行分配。

Revision.Source: Partnership excess-loss allocation mixed with other business sources remains unresolved.
Revision.Target: 合伙企业与其他经营来源混合时的超额亏损分配仍未确定。

Revision.Source: Partnership excess-loss allocation with profits, guaranteed payments or special business character remains unresolved.
Revision.Target: 涉及利润、保证付款或特殊经营税务性质的合伙企业超额亏损分配仍未确定。

Revision.Source: Profit-offset partnership excess losses require current ordinary nonpassive sources with a single loss source or the same qualified fraction, no historical losses, partner deductions, guaranteed payments or other businesses.
Revision.Target: 经利润抵减的合伙企业超额亏损，要求来源均为当期普通非被动活动，且只有一个亏损来源，或各来源的合格部分比例相同；不得涉及历史亏损、合伙人扣除、保证付款或其他业务。

Revision.Source: Provide partnership gross income for partner-deduction QBI attribution.
Revision.Target: 请提供合伙企业总收入，以确定合伙人扣除归属于 QBI 的部分。

Revision.Source: Provide partnership gross SE income for the owner-level QBI deduction allocation; net earnings cannot substitute for gross income.
Revision.Target: 请提供合伙企业的自雇总收入，以分配业主层面的 QBI 相关扣除；净收益不能代替总收入。

Revision.Source: Qualified partnership gross SE income must fit total gross SE income.
Revision.Target: 合伙企业自雇总收入中的合格部分不得超过自雇总收入。

Revision.Source: Reconcile historical partnership qualified-loss records with each separate suspended balance, including rounded totals.
Revision.Target: 请将合伙企业以往的合格亏损记录与各项独立的暂缓扣除余额核对一致，包括四舍五入后的合计金额。

Revision.Source: Reconcile partnership QBI with the resolved passive limit and partner deductions.
Revision.Target: 请根据已确定的被动活动限制和合伙人扣除，核对合伙企业的 QBI，确保一致。

Revision.Source: Reconcile qualified and total gross income for partner deductions.
Revision.Target: 请核对用于合伙人扣除的合格总收入与全部总收入，确保一致。

Revision.Source: Reconcile the rounded partnership QBI loss-year amounts and their qualified portions.
Revision.Target: 请核对四舍五入后的合伙企业各亏损年度 QBI 金额及其中的合格部分，确保一致。

Revision.Source: Resolve actual material participation for the minimum QBI deduction; nonpassive trading classification alone is insufficient.
Revision.Target: 请确定是否实际实质性参与，以计算最低 QBI 扣除额；仅归类为非被动交易活动还不够。

Revision.Source: Resolve all partnership loss-only sources before excess-loss allocation.
Revision.Target: 请先确定所有仅有亏损的合伙企业来源的处理方式，再分配超额亏损。

Revision.Source: Rounded partnership at-risk vintages do not reconcile to the at-risk worksheet.
Revision.Target: 四舍五入后，合伙企业按发生年度划分的风险承担额限制下的亏损与风险承担额计算表不一致。

Revision.Source: Rounded partnership basis-loss vintages do not reconcile to the basis worksheet.
Revision.Target: 四舍五入后，合伙企业按发生年度划分的计税基础限制下的亏损与计税基础计算表不一致。

Revision.Source: Reconcile box 14 code A after guaranteed payments: a limited partner includes only service payments, trading earnings need separate treatment, and an ordinary loss held back by basis, at-risk or passive limits needs a compatible self-employment share.
Revision.Target: 请核对扣除保证付款后的第 14 栏代码 A 金额：有限合伙人仅计入服务报酬，交易收益需要单独处理，因计税基础、风险承担额或被动活动限制而暂缓扣除的普通亏损，必须有与之相符的自雇部分。

Revision.Source: Reconcile partner financing and additional at-risk adjustments before applying loss limits.
Revision.Target: 请先核对合伙人融资及额外风险承担额调整，确保一致后再应用亏损限制。

Revision.Source: Resolve every partnership's regular self-employment source before combining this owner's earnings.
Revision.Target: 请先确定每家合伙企业在常规税下的自雇收入来源，再合并该业主的收益。

Revision.Source: Review the retained Form 6198 amounts.
Revision.Target: 请复核已保留的 Form 6198 金额。

Revision.Source: Review the retained ordinary passive-loss balance.
Revision.Target: 请复核已保留的普通被动活动亏损余额。

Revision.Source: Self-employment loss portions cannot exceed their separate retained total balances.
Revision.Target: 自雇亏损部分不得超过各自保留的亏损总余额。

Revision.Source: The partner-basis source amounts cannot be reconciled.
Revision.Target: 合伙人计税基础的原始金额无法核对一致。

Revision.Source: The partner's at-risk loss allocation is inconsistent.
Revision.Target: 合伙人在风险承担额限制下的亏损分配不一致。

Revision.Source: The partner's recapture history is inconsistent.
Revision.Target: 合伙人以往的扣除转回记录不一致。

Revision.Source: The regular-tax passive allocation does not reconcile with this partnership activity.
Revision.Target: 常规税下的被动活动分配与此合伙企业活动不一致。

Revision.Source: The retained at-risk history is inconsistent.
Revision.Target: 已保留的风险承担额历史记录不一致。

Revision.Source: The section 179 deduction allowed for this partnership does not reconcile with its K-1 box 12 amount.
Revision.Target: 此合伙企业获准扣除的第 179 条金额与其 K-1 第 12 栏金额不一致。

Revision.Source: Reconstruct opening at-risk history; outside basis cannot substitute for it. Your 2025 Form 6198 figures are needed when this K-1 has a loss, a loss carried because of the at-risk limits, a section 179 deduction or earlier losses to recapture.
Revision.Target: 请重建期初风险承担额的历史记录；合伙权益的外部计税基础不能代替该记录。如果此 K-1 涉及亏损、因风险承担额限制而结转的亏损、第 179 条扣除，或需要转回的以前年度亏损扣除，则需要您 2025 年 Form 6198 中的数据。

Revision.Source: Distribution-paid health premiums must fit the coverage total after taxable premiums and be included once in both regular and AMT cash-distribution records.
Revision.Target: 通过分配款支付的医疗保险费不得超过保险费总额扣除应税保险费后的余额，并且必须在常规税和替代性最低税（AMT）的现金分配记录中各计入一次。

Revision.Source: Resolve partnership QBI and property character before excess-loss allocation.
Revision.Target: 请先确定合伙企业的 QBI 和财产税务性质，再分配超额亏损。

Revision.Source: Schedule K-1 (1065) box 17 alternative minimum tax items beyond the separate AMT activity records (Form 6251) are not calculated.
Revision.Target: 不计算 Schedule K-1 (1065) 第 17 栏中超出单独的替代性最低税（AMT）活动记录（Form 6251）范围的替代性最低税项目。

Revision.Source: Schedule K-3 (Form 1065) Parts VI and VII (sections 951(a)(1) and 951A inclusions, passive foreign investment companies) and the Part I box 6 section 267A disallowed deduction are not calculated.
Revision.Target: 不计算 Schedule K-3 (Form 1065) 第 VI 和 VII 部分（第 951(a)(1) 和 951A 条规定的计入收入项目、被动外国投资公司），以及第 I 部分第 6 栏中根据第 267A 条不准扣除的金额。

Revision.Source: For Schedule K-1 (1065) box 22 or box 23 checked, or a statement with multiple activities, use the Partnership K-1 with a distinct-activity statement document. Enter the actual activity statement and retained loss records there; unsupported activity types still receive their own review notice.
Revision.Target: 如果 Schedule K-1 (1065) 第 22 或 23 栏已勾选，或附有多项活动明细，请使用附独立活动明细的 Partnership K-1 文档。在其中录入实际活动明细及保留的亏损记录；不支持的活动类型仍会分别收到复核提示。

Revision.Source: Schedule K-1 (1065) box 13 code O dependent care benefits (Form 2441 Part III) and a code V section 743(b) adjustment to another item are not calculated.
Revision.Target: 不计算 Schedule K-1 (1065) 第 13 栏代码 O 的受扶养人照护福利（Form 2441 第 III 部分），以及代码 V 中对其他项目作出的第 743(b) 条调整。

Revision.Source: Schedule K-1 (1065) box 6c dividend equivalents, box 11 codes B, D, I, L, M, N, O, P and ZZ, a code A portfolio loss or REMIC residual interest, a code C straddle, a code F section 743(b) adjustment to another item and gambling of a gambling business are not calculated.
Revision.Target: 不计算 Schedule K-1 (1065) 第 6c 栏的股息等价款，第 11 栏代码 B、D、I、L、M、N、O、P 和 ZZ 的项目，代码 A 的投资组合亏损或房地产抵押贷款投资渠道（REMIC）剩余权益，代码 C 的跨式交易，代码 F 中对其他项目作出的第 743(b) 条调整，以及赌博业务的赌博损益。

Revision.Source: Schedule K-1 (1065) box 20 investment income or expense totals requiring separate Form 4952 reconciliation (codes A and B), recapture, look-back interest, section 179 dispositions other than fully taxable sales, installment and section 1260 interest, precontribution gain, section 1061, inversion gain and section 48A–48D items (codes F through M, O through S, W, AL for a U.S. transferor, AM, AP, AS through AU, and ZZ with an amount) are not calculated.
Revision.Target: 不计算 Schedule K-1 (1065) 第 20 栏中需要单独与 Form 4952 核对的投资收入或费用总额（代码 A 和 B）、转回项目、回溯利息、完全应税出售以外的第 179 条财产处置、分期付款利息和第 1260 条利息、出资前收益、第 1061 条项目、企业倒置收益以及第 48A–48D 条项目（代码 F 至 M、O 至 S、W、美国转让方适用的 AL、AM、AP、AS 至 AU，以及附有金额的 ZZ）。

Revision.Source: Schedule K-1 (1065) box 19 codes B and C property distributions (sections 732 and 737) are not calculated.
Revision.Target: 不计算 Schedule K-1 (1065) 第 19 栏代码 B 和 C 的财产分配（第 732 和 737 条）。

Revision.Source: A partnership rental activity's installment sale, like-kind exchange, casualty or theft, or disposition to a related buyer needs separate property and passive-loss worksheets that this App does not calculate.
Revision.Target: 合伙企业租赁活动涉及分期付款出售、同类财产交换、灾损或失窃，或向关联买方处置财产时，需要单独的财产和被动活动亏损计算表，本应用不计算这些表格。

Revision.Source: Schedule K-1 (1065) box 9b collectibles or box 9c amounts with a box 9a long-term loss that your basis or amount at risk limits, or with a long-term loss carried from 2025, need the parts of the allowed loss, which the partner basis worksheet does not give.
Revision.Target: 如果附表 K-1（1065）第 9b 栏的收藏品金额或第 9c 栏的金额，与第 9a 栏中受计税基础或风险承担额限制的长期亏损同时存在，或与从 2025 年结转的长期亏损同时存在，则需要提供准予扣除亏损的各组成部分；合伙人计税基础工作表不提供这些明细。

Revision.Source: Review the separately stated Schedule K-1 (1065) amounts: box 6b cannot exceed box 6a.
Revision.Target: 请核查附表 K-1（1065）中单独列示的金额：第 6b 栏不得超过第 6a 栏。

Revision.Source: Taxable partnership-paid health premiums must be included in both the entered premium records and guaranteed service payments, without adding either amount twice.
Revision.Target: 合伙企业支付的应税健康保险费必须同时计入已输入的保费记录和服务类保证付款，且两处金额均不得重复计入。

Revision.Source: Section 501(c)(18)(D) contributions combined with a partially phased-out traditional IRA deduction need verified limit-ordering coordination.
Revision.Target: 第 501(c)(18)(D) 条规定的缴款与部分递减后的传统 IRA 扣除额同时存在时，需要核实并协调各项限额的适用顺序。

Revision.Source: Complete both IRA coverage records for a joint return.
Revision.Target: 联合申报时，请填写双方的 IRA 退休计划覆盖情况记录。

Revision.Source: Section 501(c)(18)(D) contributions with this employee's Roth IRA contributions or 529-to-Roth rollover require further verified contribution-limit coordination.
Revision.Target: 第 501(c)(18)(D) 条规定的缴款与该雇员的 Roth IRA 缴款或从 529 计划转入 Roth IRA 的金额同时存在时，需要进一步核实并协调缴款限额。

Revision.Source: Traditional IRA contributions exceed the remaining annual or compensation limit after section 501(c)(18)(D) contributions; resolve the excess before calculating this return.
Revision.Target: 传统 IRA 缴款超过扣除第 501(c)(18)(D) 条规定的缴款后剩余的年度限额或劳动报酬限额；请先处理超额部分，再计算本次申报。

Revision.Source: Personal-use refueling property must be placed in service during 2026 and no later than June 30.
Revision.Target: 个人使用的加注燃料设施必须在 2026 年内投入使用，且不得晚于 6 月 30 日。

Revision.Source: Post-death corrective distributions require the beneficiary's account or inheritance treatment.
Revision.Target: 账户持有人去世后的纠正性分配，须按受益人账户或继承事项处理。

Revision.Source: Post-death deemed distributions belong to the beneficiary's account treatment.
Revision.Target: 账户持有人去世后的视同分配，应按受益人账户处理。

Revision.Source: Post-death employer deposits need beneficiary or estate treatment.
Revision.Target: 账户持有人去世后的雇主存款，须按受益人或遗产的相关规则处理。

Revision.Source: Post-death HSA corrections require beneficiary or estate treatment.
Revision.Target: 账户持有人去世后的 HSA 更正，须按受益人或遗产的相关规则处理。

Revision.Source: Post-death HSA rollover activity requires beneficiary treatment.
Revision.Target: 账户持有人去世后的 HSA 滚存转账，须按受益人的相关规则处理。

Revision.Source: Post-death HSA withdrawals require beneficiary account treatment.
Revision.Target: 账户持有人去世后的 HSA 提款，须按受益人账户处理。

Revision.Source: Premiums allocated to one pension cannot exceed its available distribution after rollovers.

Revision.Target: 能源税收优惠申请需要关联已保存的实际建筑物和成本记录行。请在“出租房产”中更正来源选择。

Revision.Source: Review the physical building designation, positive conditioned area and documented ownership fraction.
Revision.Target: 请核对实际建筑物标识、大于零的供暖或制冷面积，以及有文件证明的所有权比例。

Revision.Source: Review the actual certification, license, reference standard, savings and increased-amount records.
Revision.Target: 请核对实际认证、执照、参考标准、节能量和提高优惠金额的相关记录。

Revision.Source: Select this rental's actual physical building and reconcile the unique project cost, construction and installation dates with its cost row.
Revision.Target: 请选择这项出租房产对应的实际建筑物，并核对该项目唯一记录的成本、施工日期和安装日期，确保与成本记录行一致。

Revision.Source: Enter each documentary year once, identifying all relevant claimants and its actual nonnegative deduction or absence.
Revision.Target: 请将每个有文件记录的年度仅输入一次，列明所有相关申报人，并填写该年度实际的不小于零的扣除额，或注明未申报扣除。

Revision.Source: The date you gave up the rental must be after the date it was first available to rent.
Revision.Target: 您转出出租房产的日期必须晚于该房产首次可供出租的日期。

Revision.Source: A required rental or royalty expense output cannot be represented in its native amount. No final tax can be reported.
Revision.Target: 一项必需的租赁或特许权使用费费用计算结果无法表示为其对应的金额。无法报告最终税额。

Revision.Source: The foreign rental's incidental assets need their actual ADS class lives and original no-bonus recovery records.
Revision.Target: 此境外出租物业的附属资产需要提供实际的替代折旧制度（ADS）资产类别年限，以及原始的不含额外折旧的成本回收记录。

Revision.Source: Use the actual IRS two-letter foreign country code for this property's location.
Revision.Target: 请使用 IRS 为此物业所在地指定的实际两字母外国国家代码。

Revision.Source: This rental needs its actual U.S.-possession income and recovery records before its territorial tax treatment is available.
Revision.Target: 此出租物业需要提供实际的美国属地收入和成本回收记录，才能确定其属地税务处理方式。

Revision.Source: This foreign rental needs its actual original ADS election, change-of-use or disposition history before its depreciation can be calculated.
Revision.Target: 此境外出租物业需要提供实际的原始 ADS 选择、用途变更或处置历史记录，才能计算折旧。

Revision.Source: The home-use worksheet and final AGI did not stabilize. No final tax can be reported.
Revision.Target: 住宅使用工作表与最终调整后总收入（AGI）的计算结果未能稳定。无法报告最终税额。

Revision.Source: Enter the carries from last year's home-use worksheet for this rental.
Revision.Target: 请输入此出租物业去年住宅使用工作表中的结转额。

Revision.Source: The casualty carry must be nonnegative and cannot exceed its corresponding combined carry.
Revision.Target: 灾损结转额不得为负数，且不得超过对应的合并结转额。

Revision.Source: This former home needs its original casualty activity character before the prior casualty carry can be deducted.
Revision.Target: 此原自用住宅需要提供原始灾损所属活动的性质，才能扣除以前年度的灾损结转额。

Revision.Source: The prior casualty carry needs its original qualified-business-income history before its QBI treatment is available.
Revision.Target: 以前年度的灾损结转额需要提供原始的合格营业收入历史记录，才能确定其合格营业收入（QBI）处理方式。

Revision.Source: Supply the casualty character of the prior home-use carry before separated deductions are available.
Revision.Target: 请提供以前年度住宅使用结转额中的灾损性质，才能分别计算扣除额。

Revision.Source: Supply the independently tracked prior home-use worksheet carry for this tax system.
Revision.Target: 请提供为此税制单独记录的以前年度住宅使用工作表结转额。

Revision.Source: This elected rental building needs its actual ADS recovery and conversion history before its depreciation, basis or sale can be computed.
Revision.Target: 此已作出税务选择的出租建筑需要提供实际的 ADS 成本回收和转换历史记录，才能计算折旧、计税基础或出售结果。

Revision.Source: The land part cannot exceed the cost.
Revision.Target: 土地部分的金额不得超过成本。

Revision.Source: The part of the sale price for the land cannot exceed the sale price.
Revision.Target: 售价中归属于土地的部分不得超过总售价。

Revision.Source: A separately disposed component of a mixed-use rental needs its own business basis, regular/AMT depreciation and personal-sale allocation. Whole-building sale records do not establish these component amounts.
Revision.Target: 混合用途出租物业中单独处置的组成部分，需要提供其自身的营业用途计税基础、常规税及替代性最低税（AMT）折旧，以及出售金额中个人用途部分的分配。整栋建筑的出售记录无法确定这些组成部分的金额。

Revision.Source: A saved mortgage loan can belong to only one whole-property rental. Split-property loan allocations are not supported; correct the loan selections in Rentals.
Revision.Target: 一笔已保存的抵押贷款只能归属于一项整套物业出租记录。不支持拆分物业的贷款分配；请在“出租”中更正贷款选择。

Revision.Source: For personal-use property, save the whole-property ownership share on Mortgage and select its original loans in Rentals. Leave Rental mortgage interest zero; do not enter those points or mortgage insurance again. Links require personal-use days.
Revision.Target: 对于有个人用途的物业，请在“抵押贷款”中保存您对整套物业的所有权份额，并在“出租”中选择其原始贷款。请将出租物业抵押贷款利息保留为零；不要再次输入这些贷款点数费用或抵押贷款保险费。建立关联需要填写个人使用天数。

Revision.Source: Rented days that were also personal-use days cannot exceed the days rented at a fair price.
Revision.Target: 出租期间同时用于个人用途的天数，不得超过按公允价格出租的天数。

Revision.Source: Record your real estate professional status on About you (your spouse's on About your spouse) before choosing it for a rental.
Revision.Target: 请先在“关于您”中记录您的房地产专业人士身份（配偶的身份请在“关于您的配偶”中记录），然后再为出租物业选择该身份。

Revision.Source: Resolve the sold rental's section 1231 character before completing its qualified business income.
Revision.Target: 请先确定已售出租物业根据第 1231 条规定的税务性质，再完成其合格营业收入的计算。

Revision.Source: Resolve the sold rental's single qualified activity before adding its ordinary property income.
Revision.Target: 请先确定已售出租物业所属的单一合格活动，再加入其普通财产收入。

Revision.Source: Enter the personal-use share of a property you also used.
Revision.Target: 如果您也曾将该物业用于个人用途，请输入个人使用比例。

Revision.Source: Answer whether you actively conduct this rental as a trade or business.
Revision.Target: 请回答您是否将此出租活动作为营业或业务积极经营。

Revision.Source: The date sold must be after the date the building and each improvement were first available to rent.
Revision.Target: 出售日期必须晚于建筑及各项改良工程首次可供出租的日期。

Revision.Source: The Form 1099-S box 1 date of closing must equal the date sold or the date you gave up this rental.
Revision.Target: 1099-S 表第 1 栏的交割日期必须与您出售或转出此出租物业的日期一致。

Revision.Source: The Form 1099-S box 2a total gross proceeds must equal the sale price.
Revision.Target: 1099-S 表第 2a 栏的总收入必须等于售价。

Revision.Source: Select an actual saved property of this business. Keep its disposition on that property once, and update or remove this link before deleting or moving the property.
Revision.Target: 请选择此业务中实际已保存的财产。该财产的处置仅应在其自身记录中保留一次；删除或移动该财产前，请更新或移除此关联。

Revision.Source: The distribution date must fall from the day you were ordered to active duty through the last day of the active-duty period.
Revision.Target: 领取日期必须在您接到现役服役命令之日起至该现役服役期最后一天之间。

Revision.Source: Enter each original reservist distribution once, with all its 2026 repayments.
Revision.Target: 每笔原始预备役军人领取款项仅输入一次，并包含其在 2026 年的全部偿还款。

Revision.Source: Repayments of a reservist distribution cannot add to more than the distribution.
Revision.Target: 预备役军人领取款项的偿还总额不得超过该笔领取金额。

Revision.Source: A reservist repayment must follow the end of the active-duty period and fall within two years after it.
Revision.Target: 预备役军人偿还款必须在现役服役期结束后两年内偿还。

Revision.Source: A reservist's vehicle is deducted at the standard mileage rate; choose Standard mileage rate.
Revision.Target: 预备役军人的车辆费用按标准里程费率扣除；请选择“标准里程费率”。

Revision.Source: On the final return of a person who died, a person's time in your home is counted in days through the date of death; on any other return it is counted in months.
Revision.Target: 在已故人士的最终申报表中，他人在您家中居住的时间按天计算，计至去世之日；在其他申报表中则按月计算。

Revision.Source: A person can't have lived in your home for more days than you were alive in 2026.
Revision.Target: 他人在您家中居住的天数不得超过您在 2026 年在世的天数。

Revision.Source: Enter the other entity's actual name and employer identification number from the retained gift records.
Revision.Target: 请根据留存的捐赠记录，输入另一实体的实际名称和雇主识别号码。

Revision.Source: Activity appreciation must be nonnegative and cannot exceed the retained gift's total original appreciation.
Revision.Target: 活动的增值额不得为负数，且不得超过留存捐赠记录中的原始增值总额。

Revision.Source: Enter each activity's actual original appreciation, including zero, for this basis election.
Revision.Target: 对于此计税基础选择，请输入每项活动实际的原始增值额，包括零。

Revision.Source: The identified business portions must be positive and cannot exceed this retained balance.
Revision.Target: 已确定的各业务部分金额必须为正数，且合计不得超过此留存余额。

Revision.Source: Enter each originating business only once for this retained balance.
Revision.Target: 对于此留存余额，每项来源业务只能输入一次。

Revision.Source: Select an actual eligible business on this return for each retained source portion.
Revision.Target: 请为每个留存的来源部分选择本申报表中实际符合条件的业务。

Revision.Target: 偿还的存款金额不得超过第 1 栏的分配总额。

Revision.Source: A repayment to an IRA is figured on this owner's Form 8606. Enter last year's Form 8606 and the December 31, 2026 value, or remove the repayment.
Revision.Target: 向 IRA 偿还的金额须通过该账户所有人的 8606 表计算。请输入去年的 8606 表信息及 2026 年 12 月 31 日的账户价值，或移除偿还金额。

Revision.Source: A repayment is calculated only for a birth or adoption, emergency, domestic-abuse or terminal-illness distribution from an IRA. A repayment of an employer-plan distribution is not calculated yet, so that distribution stays taxable: leave the repayment empty.
Revision.Target: 仅对 IRA 中用于生育或收养、紧急情况、家庭暴力或绝症的分配款计算偿还处理。目前尚不计算雇主计划分配款的偿还处理，因此该分配款仍须纳税：请将偿还金额留空。

Revision.Source: The amount rolled over cannot be more than box 1.
Revision.Target: 转存金额不得超过第 1 栏金额。

Revision.Source: Choose the Roth IRA code printed in box 7a: Q, J or T.
Revision.Target: 请选择第 7a 栏印列的 Roth IRA 代码：Q、J 或 T。

Revision.Source: A Roth IRA distribution can be a qualified disaster distribution; a main home purchase in a disaster area (Form 8915-F Part IV) does not apply to it.
Revision.Target: Roth IRA 分配款可以属于合格灾害分配款；灾区主要住宅购置规定（8915-F 表第 IV 部分）不适用于此类分配款。

Revision.Source: That exception applies only to a distribution from an employer plan. A Roth IRA can use disability, a first home, education, medical expenses, health insurance while unemployed, a birth or adoption, an emergency, terminal illness, domestic abuse, reservist duty, periodic payments or an IRS levy.
Revision.Target: 该例外仅适用于雇主计划的分配款。Roth IRA 可适用的例外包括残障、首次购房、教育、医疗费用、失业期间的医疗保险、生育或收养、紧急情况、绝症、家庭暴力、预备役服役、定期付款或 IRS 强制征收。

Revision.Source: For a Roth IRA (code J, Q or T) leave the other boxes empty: the Simplified Method, box 10 and disability pay do not apply. Box 9a needs nothing here.
Revision.Target: 对于 Roth IRA（代码 J、Q 或 T），请将其他栏留空：简化计算法、第 10 栏和残障津贴均不适用。此处第 9a 栏无需填写。

Revision.Source: A repayment of a Roth IRA distribution is figured on your Roth IRA history. Enter it on this page first.
Revision.Target: Roth IRA 分配款的偿还处理须根据您的 Roth IRA 历史记录计算。请先在本页输入该记录。

Revision.Source: The amount rolled over to another Roth IRA cannot be more than box 1.
Revision.Target: 转存至另一个 Roth IRA 的金额不得超过第 1 栏金额。

Revision.Source: Only money from an employer plan is rolled into a Roth account here. Money from an IRA goes to a Roth IRA as a conversion, and a SIMPLE IRA cannot be rolled to a Roth IRA in its first two years.
Revision.Target: 此处仅将来自雇主计划的款项作为转存处理并转入 Roth 账户。IRA 款项转入 Roth IRA 须作为转换处理，且 SIMPLE IRA 在最初两年内不能转存至 Roth IRA。

Revision.Source: Enter an actual same-day payment order from 1 through 100, or leave it absent when no HSA funding shares the date.
Revision.Target: 请输入 1 至 100 之间的实际同日付款顺序；如果当天没有 HSA 注资，则留空。

Revision.Source: Periodic payments and age 59½ each cover the whole distribution; they are not a second exception.
Revision.Target: 定期付款和年满 59½ 岁这两种例外各自适用于整笔分配款，不能作为第二项例外。

Revision.Source: For codes 8, E, F, N, P, R, 9 and U leave the box 2b method, the qualified disaster distribution and public safety premiums empty.
Revision.Target: 对于代码 8、E、F、N、P、R、9 和 U，请将第 2b 栏计算方法、合格灾害分配款和公共安全人员保费留空。

Revision.Source: Box 2a cannot exceed box 1 gross distribution.
Revision.Target: 第 2a 栏金额不得超过第 1 栏的分配总额。

Revision.Source: Choose how to figure this distribution's taxable amount.
Revision.Target: 请选择这笔分配款应税金额的计算方法。

Revision.Source: Answer what the printed distribution codes mean for you.
Revision.Target: 请回答表上印列的分配代码对您的情况意味着什么。

Revision.Source: A transfer of the whole Trump account to an ABLE account is not taxed: box 2a is zero.
Revision.Target: 将 Trump 账户的全部款项转入 ABLE 账户无需纳税：第 2a 栏为零。

Revision.Source: A Trump account is not an IRA for this form: leave box 7b unchecked.
Revision.Target: 就本表而言，Trump 账户不属于 IRA：请勿勾选第 7b 栏。

Revision.Source: Enter the trustee-reported basis of the acquired Trump account.
Revision.Target: 请输入受托人报告的所取得 Trump 账户的计税基础。

Revision.Source: A Trump account choice needs box 7c checked.
Revision.Target: 选择 Trump 账户时，须勾选第 7c 栏。

Revision.Source: A Trump account (box 7c) is printed with code 4, G or 8 alone. Check the form.
Revision.Target: Trump 账户（第 7c 栏）只会单独印列代码 4、G 或 8。请核对表格。

Revision.Source: Box 2b says the pension taxable amount was not determined. Select the applicable basis-recovery worksheet.
Revision.Target: 第 2b 栏表明养老金的应税金额尚未确定。请选择适用的计税基础收回计算表。

Revision.Source: The payment in box 1 is more than the account or contract value you entered.
Revision.Target: 第 1 栏的付款金额超过了您输入的账户或合同价值。

Revision.Source: Box 4 cannot exceed box 1 gross distribution.
Revision.Target: 第 4 栏金额不得超过第 1 栏的分配总额。

Revision.Source: Enter the printed box 4 value for this inherited-account distribution.
Revision.Target: 请输入这笔继承账户分配款在第 4 栏印列的价值。

Revision.Source: The earnings on the excess (box 2) cannot be more than the distribution (box 1).
Revision.Target: 超额供款产生的收益（第 2 栏）不得超过分配款（第 1 栏）。

Revision.Source: The statement's gross distribution must equal the terminated account's January1 value or the total fair market value of the pledged portions.
Revision.Target: 报表上的分配总额须等于已终止账户在 1 月 1 日的价值，或已质押部分的公允市场价值总额。

Revision.Source: Only an HSA or Archer MSA statement can report a returned excess contribution.
Revision.Target: 只有 HSA 或 Archer MSA 报表才能报告已退还的超额供款。

Revision.Source: The money spent on medical costs and the rollover cannot be more than the distribution (box 1).
Revision.Target: 用于医疗费用的金额与转存金额之和不得超过分配款（第 1 栏）。

Revision.Source: Complete the prior-year records for your own Medicare MSA.
Revision.Target: 请补全您本人 Medicare MSA 的往年记录。

Revision.Source: Answer whether this Medicare MSA was inherited from your spouse.
Revision.Target: 请回答此 Medicare MSA 是否从您的配偶处继承。

Revision.Source: Reconcile the retained payment records with the printed distribution code.
Revision.Target: 请核对保留的付款记录，使其与印列的分配代码一致。

Revision.Source: Complete this medical-account payment's records.
Revision.Target: 请补全这笔医疗账户付款的记录。

Revision.Source: Enter the printed box 3 code for a Form 1099-SA, or leave it empty for a trustee-only event.
Revision.Target: 如有 1099-SA 表，请输入第 3 栏印列的代码；如为仅由受托人记录的账户事项，则留空。

Revision.Source: The rollover cannot be deposited before the payment was received.
Revision.Target: 转存款的存入日期不得早于收到付款的日期。

Revision.Source: Only an HSA or Archer MSA payment can be rolled over to an eligible account of the same owner.
Revision.Target: 只有 HSA 或 Archer MSA 的付款才能转存至同一所有人的合格账户。

Revision.Source: A Medicare Advantage MSA inherited from your spouse is your own account: enter its payments as paid from your own account.
Revision.Target: 从配偶处继承的 Medicare Advantage MSA 视为您本人的账户：请将其付款录入为从您本人账户支付的款项。

Revision.Source: Use a trustee statement for an unreported HSA or Archer MSA account event; this is not a printed Form 1099-SA code.
Revision.Target: 对于未报告的 HSA 或 Archer MSA 账户事项，请使用受托人报表；这不是 1099-SA 表上印列的代码。

Revision.Source: Medical spending, the rollover and all dated nonmedical payments must equal this statement's gross distribution (box 1).
Revision.Target: 医疗支出、转存金额及所有注明日期的非医疗付款之和，须等于本报表的分配总额（第 1 栏）。

Revision.Source: Enter the sale's basis to use a different AMT basis.
Revision.Target: 如需使用不同的替代性最低税（AMT）计税基础，请先输入本次出售的计税基础。

Revision.Source: Enter the bond's basis to figure the market discount.
Revision.Target: 请输入债券的计税基础，以计算市场折价。

Revision.Source: Market discount applies to a bond held as an investment.
Revision.Target: 市场折价适用于作为投资持有的债券。

Revision.Source: Only an option you wrote can have negative proceeds.
Revision.Target: 只有您卖出的期权，其出售收入才可以为负数。

Revision.Source: An option premium adjustment belongs on the sale of the shares, an investment.
Revision.Target: 期权权利金调整应计入作为投资持有的股票的出售交易。

Revision.Source: Choose short-term or long-term; the form doesn't show it, so use your purchase records.
Revision.Target: 请选择短期或长期；表格未注明，请根据您的买入记录确定。

Revision.Source: A disallowed wash-sale loss cannot exceed this sale's loss.
Revision.Target: 洗售交易中不允许扣除的亏损不得超过本次出售的亏损。

Revision.Source: An option you wrote is short-term however long it was open.
Revision.Target: 您卖出的期权无论未平仓多久，均按短期处理。

Revision.Source: The required Schedule A state and local tax subtotal cannot be represented in its native amount. No final tax can be reported.
Revision.Target: 无法按所需的原始金额表示附表 A 的州及地方税小计。无法报告最终税额。

Revision.Source: The interest cannot be more than the proceeds.
Revision.Target: 利息不得超过兑付所得金额。

Revision.Source: Bonds cashed in 2026 were issued by the end of 2026. Check the earliest issue date.
Revision.Target: 2026 年兑付的债券，其发行日期须不晚于 2026 年底。请核对最早发行日期。

Revision.Source: Only bonds issued after 1989 qualify. Enter the earliest issue date from Form 8818.
Revision.Target: 只有1989年之后发行的债券才符合条件。请输入8818表上的最早发行日期。

Revision.Source: Select the accepted interest statement or annual instrument for these bonds, with the same owner and enough retained redemption interest. A linked source cannot be removed while this record remains.
Revision.Target: 请选择这些债券对应的已确认利息报表或年度凭证，其所有人必须相同，且保留计入的兑付利息必须足够。只要本记录仍存在，就不能删除关联的来源。

Revision.Source: Enter savings bonds cashed for education once for the whole return.
Revision.Target: 整份报税表中，为支付教育费用而兑付的储蓄债券只能录入一次。

Revision.Source: Saving removes a Coverdell beneficiary who is no longer a filer on this return.
Revision.Target: 保存时，将移除已不再是本报税表申报人的Coverdell受益人。

Revision.Source: Saving keeps the actual Coverdell deposits but asks for the former filer’s contributor facts.
Revision.Target: 保存时，将保留实际的Coverdell存款，但需补充原申报人作为供款人的相关信息。

Revision.Source: Saving unlinks a Coverdell correction from a source no longer present. The actual correction earnings remain recorded directly; review its source.
Revision.Target: 保存时，将解除Coverdell更正记录与已不存在的来源之间的关联。实际更正收益仍直接记录在此；请核查其来源。

Revision.Source: Income without a form, undocumented income, income with no tax form, cash income, side jobs, gig or app work, tips not reported to an employer, jury duty pay, a prize or hobby income belong to Income without a form when the person wants to add income no form shows. Existing business receipts and expenses stay on Self-employment; actual employer, monthly and payroll facts for unreported tips stay on Wages. Software depreciation, units of production, ACRS, pre-MACRS property and income forecast belong to the actual asset record under Self-employment, Farming, Rental property or Employee expenses. Form 4562 follows that activity. Find the offered tax page matching the person's request across all available sections, even when another section is currently open. Match the selected destination's documented scope, form numbers, Internal Revenue Code references and common names. Prefer the page where the person can enter or correct the requested facts over a generic overview, checklist, review or merely related page. A word mentioned to distinguish another destination does not make this page a match. For every offered page, recognize both prefixed and bare identifiers case-insensitively: Form 1098 or 1098, Form 1099-R or 1099-r, and Section 199A or 199a. Rank an exact documented identifier match ahead of broad topic matches; distinguish form suffixes such as 1098-T, 1098-E, 1098-C, 1098-VLI and 1099-QA rather than treating them as the base form. For an ambiguous subject return suitable alternatives; return no match if no offered destination fits. For Section 199A, 199a, Form 8995, 8995, Form 8995-A, 8995-A, qualified business income, QBI and QBI deduction, rank the offered Self-employment page first, unless the query names rental property, Schedule E, a partnership, S corporation or K-1: then rank that page first. A plain vehicle, car or auto query ranks Deductions first (personal car loan interest); a specific vehicle intent takes priority. An electric car's clean vehicle credit belongs to More credits, a car used for work to Self-employment, Farming or Rental property, donated clothes, goods or a car to Gifts of property and carryovers, car purchase sales tax and vehicle registration tax to Taxes you paid. Selling your house belongs to Investment sales, but a business asset, vehicle or rental sold, scrapped or condemned belongs to its own record under Self-employment, Rental property or Employee expenses. Digital assets received as pay belong to Other income, their sale to Investment sales. Incentive stock options belong to Investment sales, other alternative minimum tax items (Form 6251) to Other taxes. Form 8824 or a 1031 exchange without another qualifier belongs to Rental property. Rental income on a Schedule K-1, K-1 royalties and selling a partnership interest or S corporation shares belong to Partnerships, S corporations, estates and trusts; royalties you receive directly, to Rental property. Forms 1099-NEC and 1099-K belong to Self-employment unless you were the payer's employee (Wages, Form 8919). The S corporation that paid a W-2 is selected on Wages. Leased vehicles and Schedule C returns belong to Self-employment; solo 401(k), profit-sharing and defined-benefit plans to Self-employed health insurance and retirement plan. Investment credit (Form 3468), Form 4255 and recapture follow the property's page; solar panels, batteries or heat pumps at your home are a Form 5695 carryover on More credits. A K-1 credit statement belongs to Partnerships, S corporations, estates and trusts, K-1 and Schedule K-3 foreign taxes likewise; credits on their own source form, Form 1097-BTC and your own foreign tax credit to More credits. Form 3115 follows the activity: Self-employment first, Farming for farm or Schedule F, Rental property for rental or Schedule E; crop-share rent is Farming, not Rental property. TIPS interest, nominee components, savings-bond interest already reported, seller-financed mortgage interest and FBAR countries belong to Interest and dividends; a TIPS loss, bond-premium deductions and GST tax to Investment interest and other deductions. A child's income on the parent's return (Form 8814) belongs to Interest and dividends, Form 8615 to Your parent's return. Tuition and Form 1098-T belong to Education credits, 529 and Coverdell withdrawals (Form 1099-Q) to Prizes, scholarships, relief payments, account payouts and other income. A Roth conversion belongs to Retirement and Social Security for the Form 1099-R and to IRA contributions for the nondeductible part (Form 8606). A nanny, babysitter or daycare belongs to Child and dependent care for the care credit and to Other taxes for the household employer's Schedule H. A death in 2026 belongs to About you or About your spouse, a child who died to Children and people you support. Community property and spouses living apart belong to Your 2026 return; a registered domestic partner and a dual-status or part-year return to About you; innocent spouse relief, injured spouse allocation and the choice to treat a nonresident spouse as a resident to About your spouse.
Revision.Target: 当用户希望添加税务表格未列出的收入时，无表格收入、无凭证收入、没有税务表格的收入、现金收入、兼职、零工或平台工作收入、未向雇主申报的小费、陪审员报酬、奖金或爱好收入均归入“无表格收入”。已有业务的收入和费用仍归入“自雇”；未申报小费涉及的实际雇主、每月金额及工资信息仍归入“工资”。软件折旧、产量法、ACRS、MACRS 随所属活动归类。应在所有可用部分中查找与用户请求相符的税务页面，即使当前打开的是其他部分。根据所选目标页面记载的适用范围、表格编号、《国内税收法典》条款及常用名称进行匹配。优先选择用户可录入或更正所需信息的页面，而非一般概览、核对清单、复核页面或仅有相关性的页面。页面为区分其他目标而提及的词语，不构成匹配依据。对于每个提供的页面，均应识别带前缀及不带前缀的标识符，且不区分大小写，例如 Form A partially redeemed loan uses separate records for each released portion and the remaining pledged collateral; copy each portion's attributable original principal from the loan/release records, never repeat the entire loan principal for each part. Include every portion of a current-year advance. A warehouse release must correspond to the complete warehouse receipt identified by the CCC. Include prior loans redeemed or forfeited now, previously redeemed commodities sold now, and surplus payments received or required deficiency payments made now after an earlier CCC disposition. Do not also enter these sales, market gains or forfeitures as other farm receipts. Separate interest and ordinary fees belong in business expenses, not principal.

Revision.Source: The farming portion must first be applied to 2024, then 2025, before determining the remaining carryforward. The refund for 2024 and 2025 is claimed on Form 1045 or Form 1040-X and is not in this estimate; a note says so. The 2026 return shows the whole loss as carried forward, before the amount the earlier years absorb.
Revision.Target: 亏损中的农业部分必须先用于抵减2024年的所得，再用于抵减2025年的所得，然后才能确定可向后结转的余额。2024年和2025年的退税须通过1045表或1040-X表申请，不计入本次估算；附注中会对此加以说明。2026年纳税申报表将全部亏损列为向后结转金额，尚未扣除以前年度抵减所得所用的金额。

Revision.Source: This applies to the 2026 loss year as a whole. The election is generally irrevocable once validly made. The App calculates the carryforward but does not file the election statement.
Revision.Target: 此选择适用于整个2026亏损年度。一旦有效作出此选择，通常不可撤销。根据第172(b)条出具的放弃声明已随或将随2026年原始纳税申报表在申报截止日期前（包括获准延期后的日期）一并提交；或者，已按时提交原始申报表的申报人符合通过修正申报表在六个月内补作选择的宽限条件，并使用该程序要求的声明。本应用会计算向后结转金额，但不会提交选择声明。

The payment is not wage or business-income replacement or compensation for services. Revision.Source: From the agreed expense allocation, not the spouse's computed exclusion. Your expenses plus this amount cannot exceed the household total. Each spouse uses their own qualifying period and full base amount.
